Title: INTEGRATED SMART INDUSTRY 4.0-BASED DECISION SUPPORT FOR OPTIMIZING TACTICAL-OPERATIONAL DECISIONS: CASE STUDY
Authors: Bagheri H.; Ghavareshki M.H.K.; Abbasi M.; Fazlollahtabar H.
Abstract: The paper considers a model for an intelligent sales-distribution network that makes decisions related to marketing, inventory control, and pricing in the entire network. Considering the importance of staying in the competitive world, using machine learning tools is of great importance. A decision support system has been used to forecast the demand. Actual sales data is inserted into the decision support system, and then, using available evidence and past performance, a decision is made to estimate the demand. Then, an intelligent algorithm for solving the mathematical model is raised, which performs the model real-time using the data received from the decision support system and provides updated results. Sensitivity analysis was performed for validation. According to the obtained results, intelligent has a great impact on the objective function values and the use of real data helps in the network performance leading to cost reduction and lost sales. Two innovations used have not been investigated simultaneously in any of the previous studies. © (2025), (American Institute of Mathematical Sciences). All rights reserved.
Keywords: Decision support system; IIntegrated manage; Inventory; Pricing; Smart distribution and sales network

The focus is on automating processes related to demand forecasting and using real sales data to make informed decisions, which aligns with the definitions of Mechanical AI that involve automating processes and using data collection. There is less emphasis on analysis or emotional understanding typically associated with Thinking or Feeling AI.
resumo: O artigo considera um modelo para uma rede de distribuição de vendas inteligente que toma decisões relacionadas a marketing, controle de estoque e precificação em toda a rede. Dada a importância de se manter competitivo, o uso de ferramentas de aprendizado de máquina é fundamental. Um sistema de apoio à decisão foi utilizado para prever a demanda. Dados reais de vendas são inseridos no sistema, e, utilizando evidências disponíveis e desempenho passado, uma decisão é tomada para estimar a demanda. Em seguida, um algoritmo inteligente para resolver o modelo matemático é desenvolvido, que executa o modelo em tempo real usando os dados recebidos do sistema de apoio à decisão e fornece resultados atualizados. Uma análise de sensibilidade foi realizada para validação. De acordo com os resultados obtidos, a inteligência tem um grande impacto nos valores da função objetivo e o uso de dados reais ajuda no desempenho da rede, levando à redução de custos e vendas perdidas. Duas inovações utilizadas não foram investigadas simultaneamente em nenhum dos estudos anteriores.

Title: Understanding digitally enabled complex networks: a plural granulation based hybrid community detection approach
Authors: Gupta S.; Deodhar S.
Abstract: Purpose: Communities representing groups of agents with similar interests or functions are one of the essential features of complex networks. Finding communities in real-world networks is critical for analyzing complex systems in various areas ranging from collaborative information to political systems. Given the different characteristics of networks and the capability of community detection in handling a plethora of societal problems, community detection methods represent an emerging area of research. Contributing to this field, the authors propose a new community detection algorithm based on the hybridization of node and link granulation. Design/methodology/approach: The proposed algorithm utilizes a rough set-theoretic concept called closure on networks. Initial sets are constructed by using neighborhood topology around the nodes as well as links and represented as two different categories of granules. Subsequently, the authors iteratively obtain the constrained closure of these sets. The authors use node mutuality and link mutuality as merging criteria for node and link granules, respectively, during the iterations. Finally, the constrained closure subsets of nodes and links are combined and refined using the Jaccard similarity coefficient and a local density function to obtain communities in a binary network. Findings: Extensive experiments conducted on twelve real-world networks followed by a comparison with state-of-the-art methods demonstrate the viability and effectiveness of the proposed algorithm. Research limitations/implications: The study also contributes to the ongoing effort related to the application of soft computing techniques to model complex systems. The extant literature has integrated a rough set-theoretic approach with a fuzzy granular model (Kundu and Pal, 2015) and spectral clustering (Huang and Xiao, 2012) for node-centric community detection in complex networks. In contributing to this stream of work, the proposed algorithm leverages the unexplored synergy between rough set theory, node granulation and link granulation in the context of complex networks. Combined with experiments of network datasets from various domains, the results indicate that the proposed algorithm can effectively reveal co-occurring disjoint, overlapping and nested communities without necessarily assigning each node to a community. Practical implications: This study carries important practical implications for complex adaptive systems in business and management sciences, in which entities are increasingly getting organized into communities (Jacucci et al., 2006). The proposed community detection method can be used for network-based fraud detection by enabling experts to understand the formation and development of fraudulent setups with an active exchange of information and resources between the firms (Van Vlasselaer et al., 2017). Products and services are getting connected and mapped in every walk of life due to the emergence of a variety of interconnected devices, social networks and software applications. Social implications: The proposed algorithm could be extended for community detection on customer trajectory patterns and design recommendation systems for online products and services (Ghose et al., 2019; Liu and Wang, 2017). In line with prior research, the proposed algorithm can aid companies in investigating the characteristics of implicit communities of bloggers or social media users for their services and products so as to identify peer influencers and conduct targeted marketing (Chau and Xu, 2012; De Matos et al., 2014; Zhang et al., 2016). The proposed algorithm can be used to understand the behavior of each group and the appropriate communication strategy for that group. For instance, a group using a specific language or following a specific account might benefit more from a particular piece of content than another group. The proposed algorithm can thus help in exploring the factors defining communities and confronting many real-life challenges. Originality/value: This work is based on a theoretical argument that communities in networks are not only based on compatibility among nodes but also on the compatibility among links. Building up on the aforementioned argument, the authors propose a community detection method that considers the relationship among both the entities in a network (nodes and links) as opposed to traditional methods, which are predominantly based on relationships among nodes only. © 2021, Emerald Publishing Limited.
Keywords: Cohesion; Community; Decision support; IT artifact; Network analysis; Social computing

resumo: As comunidades que representam grupos de agentes com interesses ou funções semelhantes são características essenciais das redes complexas. A detecção de comunidades em redes do mundo real é crucial para a análise de sistemas complexos em diversas áreas, desde informações colaborativas até sistemas políticos. Este estudo propõe um novo algoritmo de detecção de comunidades baseado na hibridização da granularidade de nós e links, utilizando um conceito teórico de conjuntos aproximados chamado fechamento em redes. O algoritmo constrói conjuntos iniciais a partir da topologia de vizinhança e, em seguida, obtém iterativamente o fechamento restrito desses conjuntos, utilizando critérios de mutualidade de nós e links. Experimentos em doze redes reais demonstram a viabilidade e eficácia do algoritmo proposto. A pesquisa contribui para a aplicação de técnicas de computação suave em sistemas complexos e pode ser utilizada para detecção de fraudes em redes, além de ajudar empresas a investigar características de comunidades implícitas em mídias sociais. O trabalho sugere que as comunidades nas redes são baseadas não apenas na compatibilidade entre nós, mas também entre links, propondo um método que considera a relação entre ambas as entidades.

Title: Video marketing for decentralized finance platforms’ services
Authors: Giannakopoulos N.T.; Reklitis D.P.; Terzi M.C.; Sakas D.P.; Kanellos N.
Abstract: In the continuously evolving environment of blockchain applications, decentralized finance (DeFi) has been discerned as a favorable application among internet users. In this point of view, DeFi platforms have known increased competition with multiple similar platforms constantly emerging. Therefore, DeFi platforms should seek to promote digitally their financial services and increase the visibility of their website. This study examines the potential utilization of DeFi YouTube channel metrics for enhancing their digital marketing performance (website visibility and campaign efficiency), through statistical analyses, system dynamics (SD), and eye-tracking models. From the paper's outcomes, it becomes clear that only the YouTube metrics of the number of videos, number of comments, video interaction, channel views, and views per video can affect DeFi platforms’ website visibility and campaigns’ efficiency. Toward this purpose, neuromarketing applications (eye tracking and heatmaps) indicated that DeFi YouTube channels should select an engaging video (high interaction rate) and provide little but clear information on their home page. Apart from that, the rest of the channel’s pages should be enriched with a logical number of highly interactive short-duration videos, and not with an increasing number of videos. © The Author(s), under exclusive licence to Springer Nature Limited 2024.
Keywords: Big data; Decentralized finance (DeFi); Decision support systems (DSSs); Neuromarketing; Strategic digital marketing; Video marketing

It emphasizes the need to select engaging videos and tailor information to meet customer emotional preferences, which aligns with the focus on customer understanding and relationalization in Feeling AI.
resumo: No ambiente em constante evolução das aplicações de blockchain, as finanças descentralizadas (DeFi) têm se destacado como uma aplicação favorável entre os usuários da internet. Nesse contexto, as plataformas DeFi enfrentam uma concorrência crescente, com múltiplas plataformas semelhantes surgindo constantemente. Portanto, as plataformas DeFi devem buscar promover digitalmente seus serviços financeiros e aumentar a visibilidade de seus sites. Este estudo examina a utilização potencial das métricas de canais do YouTube de DeFi para melhorar seu desempenho em marketing digital (visibilidade do site e eficiência de campanhas), por meio de análises estatísticas, dinâmicas de sistema (SD) e modelos de rastreamento ocular. Os resultados do artigo mostram que apenas as métricas do YouTube, como número de vídeos, número de comentários, interação dos vídeos, visualizações do canal e visualizações por vídeo, podem afetar a visibilidade do site das plataformas DeFi e a eficiência das campanhas. Para isso, as aplicações de neuromarketing (rastreamento ocular e mapas de calor) indicaram que os canais DeFi no YouTube devem selecionar um vídeo envolvente (com alta taxa de interação) e fornecer informações claras, mas concisas, em sua página inicial. Além disso, as demais páginas do canal devem ser enriquecidas com um número lógico de vídeos curtos e altamente interativos, e não com um número crescente de vídeos.

Title: Unveiling just-in-time decision support system using social media analytics: a case study on reverse logistics resource recycling
Authors: Shahidzadeh M.H.; Shokouhyar S.
Abstract: Purpose: In recent times, the field of corporate intelligence has gained substantial prominence, employing advanced data analysis techniques to yield pivotal insights for instantaneous strategic and tactical decision-making. Expanding beyond rudimentary post observation and analysis, social media analytics unfolds a comprehensive exploration of diverse data streams encompassing social media platforms and blogs, thereby facilitating an all-encompassing understanding of the dynamic social customer landscape. During an extensive evaluation of social media presence, various indicators such as popularity, impressions, user engagement, content flow, and brand references undergo meticulous scrutiny. Invaluable intelligence lies within user-generated data stemming from social media platforms, encompassing valuable customer perspectives, feedback, and recommendations that have the potential to revolutionize numerous operational facets, including supply chain management. Despite its intrinsic worth, the actual business value of social media data is frequently overshadowed due to the pervasive abundance of content saturating the digital realm. In response to this concern, the present study introduces a cutting-edge system known as the Enterprise Just-in-time Decision Support System (EJDSS). Design/methodology/approach: Leveraging deep learning techniques and advanced analytics of social media data, the EJDSS aims to propel business operations forward. Specifically tailored to the domain of marketing, the framework delineates a practical methodology for extracting invaluable insights from the vast expanse of social data. This scholarly work offers a comprehensive overview of fundamental principles, pertinent challenges, functional aspects, and significant advancements in the realm of extensive social data analysis. Moreover, it presents compelling real-world scenarios that vividly illustrate the tangible advantages companies stand to gain by incorporating social data analytics into their decision-making processes and capitalizing on emerging investment prospects. Findings: To substantiate the efficacy of the EJDSS, a detailed case study centered around reverse logistics resource recycling is presented, accompanied by experimental findings that underscore the system’s exceptional performance. The study showcases remarkable precision, robustness, F1 score, and variance statistics, attaining impressive figures of 83.62%, 78.44%, 83.67%, and 3.79%, respectively. Originality/value: This scholarly work offers a comprehensive overview of fundamental principles, pertinent challenges, functional aspects, and significant advancements in the realm of extensive social data analysis. Moreover, it presents compelling real-world scenarios that vividly illustrate the tangible advantages companies stand to gain by incorporating social data analytics into their decision-making processes and capitalizing on emerging investment prospects. © 2024, Emerald Publishing Limited.
Keywords: Decision support system; Deep learning; Industry 5.0; Socialmedia analytics

resumo: O campo da inteligência corporativa tem ganhado destaque, utilizando técnicas avançadas de análise de dados para fornecer insights cruciais para a tomada de decisões estratégicas e táticas. A análise de mídias sociais vai além da observação e análise simples, explorando diversas fontes de dados, incluindo plataformas de mídias sociais e blogs, para entender o dinâmico cenário do cliente social. Durante a avaliação da presença nas mídias sociais, indicadores como popularidade, impressões, engajamento do usuário, fluxo de conteúdo e referências à marca são analisados. Dados gerados por usuários em plataformas de mídias sociais oferecem perspectivas valiosas dos clientes, feedback e recomendações que podem transformar várias operações, como a gestão da cadeia de suprimentos. No entanto, o valor comercial real desses dados muitas vezes é ofuscado pela abundância de conteúdo digital. Para abordar essa questão, o estudo apresenta um sistema inovador chamado Sistema de Suporte à Decisão Just-in-time para Empresas (EJDSS). Utilizando técnicas de aprendizado profundo e análises avançadas de dados sociais, o EJDSS visa impulsionar as operações comerciais, especialmente na área de marketing, delineando uma metodologia prática para extrair insights valiosos. O trabalho oferece uma visão abrangente dos princípios fundamentais, desafios, aspectos funcionais e avanços significativos na análise de dados sociais. Além disso, apresenta cenários do mundo real que ilustram as vantagens tangíveis que as empresas podem obter ao incorporar a análise de dados sociais em seus processos de tomada de decisão. Para validar a eficácia do EJDSS, um estudo de caso detalhado sobre reciclagem de recursos em logística reversa é apresentado, demonstrando o desempenho excepcional do sistema com precisão, robustez e estatísticas de variância impressionantes.

Title: A decision support system to evaluate the quality and warranty policies for remanufactured products
Authors: Kuik S.; Ban J.; Diong L.; Qi X.
Abstract: Purpose: This paper proposes optimisation models to evaluate and examine the selling of extended warranty policies in terms of improved profits in producing/marketing remanufactured products. These models are numerically solved using a quadratic programming solution approach and implemented in the decision support system (DSS). Design/methodology/approach: The purpose of this paper is to develop the optimisation models for a DSS and evaluate different warranty policies for buyers. Findings: This study has demonstrated the flexibility and usefulness of a model-driven DSS for the quality and warranty management, which is applied to examine and evaluate different configurations (i.e. component reuse, rebuild and recycle) for remanufactured products and propose the selling of extended warranty policies for buyers. Research limitations/implications: The developed model-driven DSS can assist manufacturers to select and increase the number of components, e.g. to be reused, rebuilt, and recycled for producing a remanufactured product and propose suitable warranty policies for buyers. However, this study focusses only on the evaluation of warranty policies for specific remanufactured products in a DSS, i.e. types of air compressors for production operations in manufacturing industry. Originality/value: This study developed optimisation models to be used in a DSS for proposing the selling of extended warranty of a remanufactured product to improve customer satisfaction and maximise the gained profits for manufacturers. © 2022, Emerald Publishing Limited.
Keywords: Decision support system; Product remanufacturing; Quality management; Reliability; Warranty

This aligns with the Mechanical AI category, which focuses on automating processes to meet customer needs and enhancing marketing strategies through data-driven approaches. The emphasis on improving profits through marketing remanufactured products indicates an automated approach to market analysis and segmentation, which are key aspects of Mechanical AI.
resumo: Este artigo propõe modelos de otimização para avaliar e examinar a venda de políticas de garantia estendida, visando melhorar os lucros na produção e comercialização de produtos remanufaturados. Os modelos são resolvidos numericamente por meio de uma abordagem de programação quadrática e implementados em um sistema de suporte à decisão (DSS). O estudo demonstrou a flexibilidade e utilidade de um DSS orientado por modelos para a gestão de qualidade e garantia, aplicado na avaliação de diferentes configurações (como reutilização, reconstrução e reciclagem) de produtos remanufaturados, além de propor a venda de políticas de garantia estendida para os compradores. O DSS desenvolvido pode ajudar os fabricantes a selecionar e aumentar o número de componentes a serem reutilizados, reconstruídos e reciclados na produção de um produto remanufaturado, propondo políticas de garantia adequadas. No entanto, o estudo se concentra apenas na avaliação de políticas de garantia para produtos remanufaturados específicos, como tipos de compressores de ar na indústria de manufatura. Este estudo desenvolveu modelos de otimização para serem utilizados em um DSS, propondo a venda de garantias estendidas de produtos remanufaturados para melhorar a satisfação do cliente e maximizar os lucros obtidos pelos fabricantes.

Title: Text mining-based four-step framework for smart speaker product improvement and sales planning
Authors: Park J.; Yang D.; Kim H.Y.
Abstract: The smart speaker market, which is considered an early-stage market, is expected to grow rapidly as smart speakers become a part of daily life. Consequently, manufacturers are trying to dominate the market. To achieve this, they must analyze users' reactions to their products and find insights for product improvement through comparison with competitors. We propose a four-step methodological framework for identifying meaningful opinions from a large number of online user reviews. First, network analysis is conducted to compare differences between brands. Next, through topic modeling, the attributes of speakers that users consider the most crucial are extracted for each brand. Third, sentiment analysis is conducted to examine how users' emotional polarities differ for each attribute. Through this, product improvement and product sales plans can be derived. Finally, in order to clarify the strengths and weaknesses of each brand, brand positioning is conducted and user opinions that have changed along with the evolution of the speaker's generation are analyzed. Our study identified the factors that positively or negatively affect the experience of smart speaker users. In addition, the proposed method is highly useful because it can be used to derive insights from a large amount of user opinion data regardless of the search term. © 2022 Elsevier Ltd
Keywords: Brand positioning; Decision support; Online review; Sales planning; Smart speaker; Text analysis
keywords: market analysis, user opinions, product improvement, sentiment analysis, brand positioning
rationale: The abstract discusses a methodological framework that conducts network analysis, topic modeling, and sentiment analysis to derive insights from user reviews. This indicates a strong focus on market analysis and understanding competitive advantages, which aligns with the definitions and examples under the Thinking AI category.
resumo: O mercado de alto-falantes inteligentes, considerado em estágio inicial, deve crescer rapidamente à medida que esses dispositivos se tornam parte da vida cotidiana. Os fabricantes buscam dominar o mercado analisando as reações dos usuários e encontrando insights para melhorar os produtos em comparação com os concorrentes. Propomos um framework metodológico em quatro etapas para identificar opiniões significativas a partir de um grande número de avaliações de usuários online. Primeiro, é realizada uma análise de rede para comparar as diferenças entre as marcas. Em seguida, através da modelagem de tópicos, são extraídos os atributos que os usuários consideram mais importantes para cada marca. A terceira etapa envolve a análise de sentimentos para examinar como as polaridades emocionais dos usuários diferem para cada atributo. Com isso, podem ser elaborados planos de melhoria de produtos e vendas. Por fim, para esclarecer os pontos fortes e fracos de cada marca, é feita uma análise de posicionamento de marca e as opiniões dos usuários que mudaram com a evolução da geração dos alto-falantes são analisadas. O estudo identificou fatores que afetam positiva ou negativamente a experiência dos usuários de alto-falantes inteligentes. Além disso, o método proposto é altamente útil, pois pode ser utilizado para extrair insights de uma grande quantidade de dados de opiniões de usuários, independentemente do termo de busca.

Title: Information analysis for dynamic sale planning by AI decision support process
Authors: Wang F.; Luan Y.; Badawi A.N.; Ayad A.; Abdallah A.F.; Ali M.; Ahmad Z.; Jiang W.
Abstract: Marketing is all about finding out what your customers want and need. The information is used to create the model and improve the quality of products and services to satisfy customers. There are two major parts to a sale's planning: containing sales tactics and sales strategy. To aid in business decision-making, a data warehouse (DW) for sales collects and organizes relevant and historical data. DW is also a method for combining data from various heterogeneous databases (DB) and other sources of information for analysis. In this paper, Information analysis for dynamic Sale planning by AI Decision support process was done. Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) and Quantum Particle Swarm Optimization (QPSO) algorithms have been used to find optimal MVs for sale planning since several authors prove that these algorithms are better than other existing algorithms. MVs selection is based on three factors: time running of MVs, area of MVs, and access frequency of MVs by manipulating the selection result using a weighted combination of each factor as needed by the designer. For PSO, the most cost of frequency was 1.924 for View (V) 11, while for QPSO, it was 1.722 for V11. For PSO, the most cost of time was 1.931 for V2, while for QPSO, it was 1.221 for V22. For PSO, the most cost of the area was 1.800 for V17, while for QPSO, it was 1.071 for V17. The results revealed that Quantum Particle Swarm Optimization is much more accurate than Particle Swarm Optimization. © 2023 Elsevier Ltd
Keywords: Artificial intelligence AI; Database management system; Decision support process; Information analysis; Particle swarm optimization; Sale planning

rationale: The abstract discusses the use of AI algorithms, specifically PSO and QPSO, for optimizing sales planning based on various factors. This aligns with the focus on market analysis and targeting, as it involves analyzing data to improve sales strategies and decision-making. The emphasis on data collection and analysis for sales optimization fits well within the Thinking AI category, which focuses on market analysis and strategic decision-making.
resumo: O marketing se concentra em identificar o que os clientes desejam e necessitam, utilizando essas informações para criar modelos e aprimorar a qualidade de produtos e serviços. O planejamento de vendas envolve táticas e estratégias de vendas. Um armazém de dados (DW) para vendas coleta e organiza dados relevantes e históricos, servindo como um método para combinar dados de diferentes bancos de dados e fontes de informação para análise. Este artigo analisa o planejamento dinâmico de vendas por meio de um processo de suporte à decisão baseado em IA. Os algoritmos Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) e Quantum Particle Swarm Optimization (QPSO) foram utilizados para encontrar variáveis de decisão ótimas para o planejamento de vendas, demonstrando ser superiores a outros algoritmos existentes. A seleção das variáveis de decisão é baseada em três fatores: tempo de execução, área e frequência de acesso, manipulando os resultados com uma combinação ponderada de cada fator conforme necessário. Os resultados mostraram que o QPSO é significativamente mais preciso que o PSO.

Title: Artificial intelligence-based predictions of movie audiences on opening Saturday
Authors: An Y.; An J.; Cho S.
Abstract: Marketing activity by distributors is a significant factor in attracting audiences to theaters before a movie is released. Importantly, audience numbers on opening weekend are highly affected by marketing activity before the release, and these numbers determine how many screens will be allocated to the movie. Therefore, distributors need to predict audience numbers on opening weekend and develop marketing strategies in order to gain a competitive advantage over other films being screened at the same time. However, as distributors make predictions based on their experiences and intuitions, it is difficult to quantify the reliability of predicted values and deliver the correct marketing strategy. In this study, we propose a model that predicts audience numbers on the opening Saturday using market research data obtained through online and offline surveys to help distributors develop better marketing strategies. © 2020 International Institute of Forecasters
Keywords: Artificial intelligence; Box office; Decision support system; Machine learning; Marketing

rationale: The abstract discusses how distributors can predict audience numbers for a movie's opening weekend using market research data, which relates to market analysis and competitive advantage, aligning with the Thinking AI category. The focus is on the strategic use of data to inform marketing decisions.
resumo: A atividade de marketing realizada pelos distribuidores é um fator significativo na atração de públicos para os cinemas antes do lançamento de um filme. Os números de público no fim de semana de estreia são fortemente influenciados por essa atividade de marketing, e esses números determinam quantas telas serão alocadas ao filme. Portanto, os distribuidores precisam prever o público no fim de semana de estreia e desenvolver estratégias de marketing para obter uma vantagem competitiva em relação a outros filmes que estão sendo exibidos ao mesmo tempo. No entanto, como as previsões dos distribuidores são baseadas em experiências e intuições, é difícil quantificar a confiabilidade dos valores previstos e entregar a estratégia de marketing correta. Neste estudo, propomos um modelo que prevê o número de espectadores no sábado de abertura utilizando dados de pesquisa de mercado obtidos por meio de pesquisas online e offline, para ajudar os distribuidores a desenvolver melhores estratégias de marketing.

Title: Performance evaluation for competency of bank telemarketing prediction using data mining techniques
Authors: Rashid Farooqi M.; Iqbal N.
Abstract: In today's market there is cut throat competition in the banks and struggling hard to gain competitive advantage over each other. The banking industry has undergone tremendous changes in the way business conducted. They realizes the needs and techniques of data mining which is helpful tool to gather, store, capture data and convert into knowledge. The application of data mining enhances the performance of telemarketing process in banking industry. It also provide an insight how these techniques effectively used in banking industry to make the decision making process easier and productive. This work describes a data mining approach to extract valuable knowledge and information from a bank telemarketing campaign data. At this time, the potential of five data mining methods was explored for forecasting of term deposit subscription. The presentation of these techniques was evaluated on fourteen different classifier parameters. The overall better performance achieved by J48 decision tree which reported 91.2% correctly classified with sensitivity, specificity and lowest error rate of 53.8, 95.9 and 8.8 % respectively. © BEIESP.
Keywords: Bank telemarketing; Classification; Data mining; Decision support; Direct marketing
Publisher: Blue Eyes Intelligence Engineering and Sciences Publication
keywords: data mining, telemarketing process, data collection, forecasting, decision making, bank telemarketing campaign

This aligns with the Mechanical AI category, which focuses on data collection and automated processes. Although there are elements of decision-making and performance evaluation, the primary focus remains on data mining as a tool for data collection and analysis.
resumo: No mercado atual, a competição entre os bancos é intensa, e eles lutam para obter vantagem competitiva. A indústria bancária passou por mudanças significativas na forma como os negócios são conduzidos, reconhecendo a importância das técnicas de mineração de dados como ferramentas úteis para coletar, armazenar e transformar dados em conhecimento. A aplicação da mineração de dados melhora o desempenho do processo de telemarketing na indústria bancária, facilitando a tomada de decisões. Este trabalho descreve uma abordagem de mineração de dados para extrair conhecimento valioso de dados de campanhas de telemarketing bancário, explorando cinco métodos de mineração de dados para prever a adesão a depósitos a prazo. A apresentação dessas técnicas foi avaliada em quatorze parâmetros de classificadores, com o algoritmo J48 apresentando o melhor desempenho, classificando corretamente 91,2% dos casos, com sensibilidade, especificidade e taxa de erro de 53,8%, 95,9% e 8,8%, respectivamente.

Title: Reactance to Recommendations: When Unsolicited Advice Yields Contrary Responses
Authors: Fitzsimons G.J.; Lehmann D.R.
Abstract: Recommendations often play a positive role in the decision process by reducing the difficulty associated with choosing between options. However, in certain circumstances recommendations play a less positive and more undesirable role from the perspectives of both the recommending agent or agency and the person receiving the recommendation. Across a series of four studies, we explore consumer response when recommendations by experts and intelligent agents contradict the consumer's initial impressions of choice options. We find that unsolicited advice that contradicts initial impressions leads to the activation of a reactant state on the part of the decision maker. This reactance, in turn, leads to a behavioral backlash that results not only in consumers ignoring the agents' recommendations but in intentionally contradicting them.
Keywords: Decision support systems; Intelligent agents; Internet marketing; Recommendations
Publisher: INFORMS Inst.for Operations Res.and the Management Sciences

This aligns with the category of Feeling AI, which emphasizes understanding customer emotions and tailoring interactions based on those emotions. The mention of behavioral backlash further indicates a focus on customer understanding and relationalization.
resumo: As recomendações geralmente desempenham um papel positivo no processo de decisão, facilitando a escolha entre opções. No entanto, em certas circunstâncias, elas podem ter um efeito negativo tanto para quem recomenda quanto para quem recebe a recomendação. Em uma série de quatro estudos, exploramos a resposta dos consumidores quando recomendações de especialistas e agentes inteligentes contradizem as impressões iniciais dos consumidores sobre as opções de escolha. Descobrimos que conselhos não solicitados que contradizem as impressões iniciais ativam um estado de reatividade no tomador de decisão, levando a uma reação comportamental que resulta não apenas na ignorância das recomendações, mas também em uma contrariedade intencional a elas.

Title: Using social media to identify tourism attractiveness in six Italian cities
Authors: Giglio S.; Bertacchini F.; Bilotta E.; Pantano P.
Abstract: The technological revolution and the widespread of social media have allowed people to generate tremendous amounts of data every day. Social networks provide users with access to information. This paper aims to determine the attractiveness of various tourism sites by investigating the behaviour of users through social media. The database involves geo-tagged photos located in six cities serving as a relevant artistic and cultural hub in Italy. Photos downloaded from Flickr, a data-sharing platform. Data analysis was conducted using Mathematica and Machine Learning models approach. The results of our study show maps of the users’ behaviour identify the annual trend of photographic activity in cities and highlight the effectiveness of the proposed methodology that is able to provide with place and user information. The study underline how the analysis of social data can to create a predictive model to formulate tourism scenarios. At the end, general tourism marketing strategies are discussed. © 2018 Elsevier Ltd
Keywords: Big data; City attractiveness; Decision support; Flickr geo-tags; Tourist behaviour
keywords: social media, user behavior, predictive model, tourism scenarios, data analysis
rationale: The abstract discusses the analysis of user behavior through social media data to understand the attractiveness of tourism sites. It utilizes machine learning models and predictive analytics to formulate tourism scenarios, which aligns well with the market analysis focus of Thinking AI. The study emphasizes identifying trends and user behavior, which is fundamental in strategic marketing analysis.
resumo: A revolução tecnológica e a disseminação das redes sociais permitiram que as pessoas gerassem enormes quantidades de dados diariamente. As redes sociais oferecem aos usuários acesso à informação. Este artigo tem como objetivo determinar a atratividade de vários locais turísticos, investigando o comportamento dos usuários por meio das redes sociais. A base de dados envolve fotos geo-referenciadas localizadas em seis cidades que servem como um importante centro artístico e cultural na Itália. As fotos foram baixadas do Flickr, uma plataforma de compartilhamento de dados. A análise dos dados foi realizada utilizando Mathematica e modelos de aprendizado de máquina. Os resultados do nosso estudo mostram mapas do comportamento dos usuários que identificam a tendência anual da atividade fotográfica nas cidades e destacam a eficácia da metodologia proposta, que é capaz de fornecer informações sobre locais e usuários. O estudo ressalta como a análise de dados sociais pode criar um modelo preditivo para formular cenários turísticos. Ao final, estratégias gerais de marketing turístico são discutidas.

Title: MOVIEMOD: An implementable decision-support system for prerelease market evaluation of motion pictures
Authors: Eliashberg J.; Jonker J.-J.; Sawhney M.S.; Wierenga B.
Abstract: In spite of the high financial stakes involved in marketing new motion pictures, marketing science models have not been applied to the prerelease market evaluation of motion pictures. The motion picture industry poses some unique challenges. For example, the consumer adoption process for movies is very sensitive to word-of-mouth interactions, which are difficult to measure and predict before the movie has been released. In this article, we undertake the challenge to develop and implement MOVIEMOD - a prerelease market evaluation model for the motion picture industry. MOVIEMOD is designed to generate box-office forecasts and to support marketing decisions for a new movie after the movie has been produced (or when it is available in a rough cut) but before it has been released. Unlike other forecasting models for motion pictures, the calibration of MOVIEMOD does not require any actual sales data. Also, the data collection time for a product with a limited lifetime such as a movie should not take too long. For MOVIEMOD it takes only three hours in a "consumer clinic" to collect the data needed for the prediction of box-office sales and the evaluation of alternative marketing plans. The model is based on a behavioral representation of the consumer adoption process for movies as a macroflow process. The heart of MOVIEMOD is an interactive Markov chain model describing the macro-flow process. According to this model, at any point in time with respect to the movie under study, a consumer can be found in one of the following behavioral states: undecided, considerer, rejecter, positive spreader, negative spreader, and inactive. The progression of consumers through the behavioral states depends on a set of movie-specific factors that are related to the marketing mix, as well as on a set of more general behavioral factors that characterize the movie-going behavior in the population of interest. This interactive Markov chain model allows us to account for word-of-mouth interactions among potential adopters and several types of word-of-mouth spreaders in the population. Marketing variables that influence the transitions among the states are movie theme acceptability, promotion strategy, distribution strategy, and the movie experience. The model is calibrated in a consumer clinic experiment. Respondents fill out a questionnaire with general items related to their movie-going and movie communication behavior, they are exposed to different sets of information stimuli, they are actually shown the movie, and finally, they fill out postmovie evaluations, including word-of-mouth intentions. These measures are used to estimate the word-of-mouth parameters and other behavioral factors, as well as the movie-specific parameters of the model. MOVIEMOD produces forecasts of the awareness, adoption intention, and cumulative penetration for a new movie within the population of interest for a given base marketing plan. It also provides diagnostic information on the likely impact of alternative marketing plans on the commercial performance of a new movie. We describe two applications of MOVIEMOD: One is a pilot study conducted without studio cooperation in the United States, and the other is a full-fledged implementation conducted with cooperation of the movie's distributor and exhibitor in the Netherlands. The implementations suggest that MOVIEMOD produces reasonably accurate forecasts of box-office performance. More importantly, the model offers the opportunity to simulate the effects of alternative marketing plans. In the Dutch application, the effects of extra advertising, extra magazine articles, extra TV commercials, and higher trailer intensity (compared to the base marketing plan of the distributor) were analyzed. We demonstrate the value of these decision-support capabilities of MOVIEMOD in assisting managers to identify a final plan that resulted in an almost 50% increase in the test movie's revenue performance, compared to the marketing plan initially contemplated. Management implemented this recommended plan, which resulted in box-office sales that were within 5% of the MOVIEMOD prediction. MOVIEMOD was also tested against several benchmark models, and its prediction was better in all cases. An evaluation of MOVIEMOD jointly by the Dutch exhibitor and the distributor showed that both parties were positive about and appreciated its performance as a decision-support tool. In particular, the distributor, who has more stakes in the domestic performance of its movies, showed a great interest in using MOVIEMOD for subsequent evaluations of new movies prior to their release. Based on such evaluations and the initial validation results, MOVIEMOD can fruitfully (and inexpensively) be used to provide researchers and managers with a deeper understanding of the factors that drive audience response to new motion pictures, and it can be instrumental in developing other decision-support systems that can improve the odds of commercial success of new experiential products.
Keywords: Decision support; Forecasting; Markov chains; Motion pictures; New products; Pretest market evaluation

rationale: The abstract discusses the development of MOVIEMOD, a model designed for prerelease market evaluation in the motion picture industry. It focuses on generating box-office forecasts and supporting marketing decisions through analysis of consumer behavior and interactions. The model simulates effects of various marketing strategies, aligning with the market analysis and targeting aspects of Thinking AI. The emphasis on forecasting and evaluating marketing plans further supports this classification.
resumo: Apesar dos altos riscos financeiros envolvidos na comercialização de novos filmes, modelos de ciência do marketing não foram aplicados à avaliação de mercado pré-lançamento na indústria cinematográfica. Este setor apresenta desafios únicos, como a sensibilidade do processo de adoção do consumidor a interações de boca a boca, que são difíceis de medir antes do lançamento do filme. Este artigo apresenta o MOVIEMOD, um modelo de avaliação de mercado pré-lançamento, projetado para gerar previsões de bilheteira e apoiar decisões de marketing após a produção do filme, mas antes de seu lançamento. O MOVIEMOD não requer dados de vendas reais para sua calibração e coleta os dados necessários em apenas três horas em uma "clínica de consumidores". O modelo é baseado em uma representação comportamental do processo de adoção do consumidor e utiliza uma cadeia de Markov interativa para descrever esse processo. Os consumidores podem estar em diferentes estados comportamentais, e a progressão entre esses estados depende de fatores específicos do filme e de fatores comportamentais gerais. O MOVIEMOD produz previsões de conscientização, intenção de adoção e penetração cumulativa para um novo filme e fornece informações diagnósticas sobre o impacto de planos de marketing alternativos. Duas aplicações do MOVIEMOD foram descritas, uma nos Estados Unidos e outra na Holanda, onde o modelo demonstrou previsões precisas de desempenho nas bilheteiras. A aplicação na Holanda analisou os efeitos de estratégias de marketing alternativas, resultando em um aumento significativo na receita do filme testado. A avaliação conjunta do MOVIEMOD por exibidores e distribuidores na Holanda mostrou uma recepção positiva, com interesse em sua utilização para avaliações futuras. O MOVIEMOD pode ser uma ferramenta valiosa e econômica para entender os fatores que influenciam a resposta do público a novos filmes e para desenvolver outros sistemas de suporte à decisão que melhorem as chances de sucesso comercial de novos produtos.

Title: Customizing promotions in online stores
Authors: Zhang J.; Krishnamurthi L.
Abstract: The main objective of this paper is to provide a decision-support system of micro-level customized promotions, primarily for use in online stores. Our proposed approach utilizes the one-on-one and interactive nature of the Internet shopping environment and provides recommendations on when to promote how much to whom. We address the issue by first constructing a joint purchase incidence-brand choice-purchase quantity model that incorporates how variety-seeking/inertia tendency differs among households and change over time for the same household. Based on the model, we develop an optimization procedure to derive the optimal amount of price discount for each household on each shopping trip. We demonstrate that the proposed customization method could greatly improve the effectiveness of current promotion practices, and discuss the implications for retailers and consumer packaged goods companies in the age of Internet technology.
Keywords: Brand choice; Customized promotions; Decision support system; Econometric models; Inertia; Internet marketing; Personalized marketing; Profit optimization; Purchase incidence; Purchase quantity; Variety-seeking
keywords: decision-support system, customized promotions, recommendations, optimization procedure, price discount
rationale: The abstract discusses the development of a decision-support system aimed at optimizing promotional strategies for online stores. The focus on making recommendations for personalized promotions based on the modeling of consumer behavior aligns closely with the 'Targeting' and 'Personalization' aspects of Thinking AI. The approach analyzes consumer tendencies and seeks to improve marketing effectiveness through data-driven insights, which is characteristic of market analysis.
resumo: O principal objetivo deste artigo é fornecer um sistema de suporte à decisão para promoções personalizadas em nível micro, principalmente para uso em lojas online. Nossa abordagem proposta utiliza a natureza interativa do ambiente de compras na Internet e fornece recomendações sobre quando e quanto promover para cada consumidor. Abordamos a questão construindo um modelo que incorpora a incidência de compras conjuntas, escolha de marca e quantidade de compra, considerando como a busca por variedade e a inércia diferem entre os lares e mudam ao longo do tempo para o mesmo lar. Com base no modelo, desenvolvemos um procedimento de otimização para determinar o desconto de preço ideal para cada lar em cada compra. Demonstramos que o método de personalização proposto pode melhorar significativamente a eficácia das práticas de promoção atuais e discutimos as implicações para varejistas e empresas de bens de consumo na era da tecnologia da Internet.

Title: A dynamic decision support system to predict the value of customer for new product development
Authors: Chan S.L.; Ip W.H.
Abstract: In recent years, firms have focused on how to enter markets and meet customer requirements by improving product attributes and processes to boost their market share and profits. Consequently, market-driven product design and development has become a popular topic in the literature. However, past research neither covers all of the major influencing factors that together drive customers to make purchase decisions, nor connects these various influencing factors to customer purchasing behavior. Past studies further fail to take the time value of money and customer value into consideration. This study proposes a decision support system to (a) predict customer purchasing behavior given certain product, customer, and marketing influencing factors, and (b) estimate the net customer lifetime value from customer purchasing behavior toward a specific product. This will not only enable decision-makers to compare alternatives and select competitive products to launch on the market, but will also improve the understanding of customer behavior toward particular products for the formulation of effective marketing strategies that increase customer loyalty and generate greater profits in the long term. Decision-makers can also make use of the system to build up confidence in new product development in terms of idea generation and product improvement. The application of the proposed system is illustrated and confirmed to be sensible and convincing through a case study. © 2011 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved.
Keywords: Customer relationships; Decision support systems; New product development; Value of customer
keywords: customer purchasing behavior, decision support system, market-driven product design, customer lifetime value, effective marketing strategies
rationale: The abstract discusses a decision support system designed to predict customer purchasing behavior and estimate customer lifetime value, which aligns well with the focus on market analysis and targeting in the Thinking AI category. The emphasis on understanding customer behavior for effective marketing strategies further supports this classification.
resumo: Nos últimos anos, as empresas têm se concentrado em como entrar nos mercados e atender às necessidades dos clientes, melhorando atributos e processos dos produtos para aumentar sua participação de mercado e lucros. Como resultado, o design e desenvolvimento de produtos orientados pelo mercado tornaram-se um tema popular na literatura. No entanto, pesquisas anteriores não abordam todos os principais fatores que influenciam as decisões de compra dos clientes nem conectam esses fatores ao comportamento de compra. Além disso, os estudos anteriores não consideram o valor do tempo do dinheiro e o valor do cliente. Este estudo propõe um sistema de suporte à decisão para (a) prever o comportamento de compra dos clientes com base em certos fatores influenciadores de produto, cliente e marketing, e (b) estimar o valor líquido do tempo de vida do cliente a partir do comportamento de compra em relação a um produto específico. Isso permitirá que os tomadores de decisão comparem alternativas e selecionem produtos competitivos para lançar no mercado, além de melhorar a compreensão do comportamento do cliente em relação a produtos específicos para a formulação de estratégias de marketing eficazes que aumentem a lealdade do cliente e gerem maiores lucros a longo prazo. Os tomadores de decisão também poderão utilizar o sistema para aumentar a confiança no desenvolvimento de novos produtos em termos de geração de ideias e melhoria de produtos. A aplicação do sistema proposto é ilustrada e confirmada como sensata e convincente através de um estudo de caso.

Title: 50 years of data mining and OR: Upcoming trends and challenges
Authors: Baesens B.; Mues C.; Martens D.; Vanthienen J.
Abstract: Data mining involves extracting interesting patterns from data and can be found at the heart of operational research (OR), as its aim is to create and enhance decision support systems. Even in the early days, some data mining approaches relied on traditional OR methods such as linear programming and forecasting, and modern data mining methods are based on a wide variety of OR methods including linear and quadratic optimization, genetic algorithms and concepts based on artificial ant colonies. The use of data mining has rapidly become widespread, with applications in domains ranging from credit risk, marketing, and fraud detection to counter-terrorism. In all of these, data mining is increasingly playing a key role in decision making. Nonetheless, many challenges still need to be tackled, ranging from data quality issues to the problem of how to include domain experts' knowledge, or how to monitor model performance. In this paper, we outline a series of upcoming trends and challenges for data mining and its role within OR. © 2009 Operational Research Society Ltd. All rights reserved.
Keywords: Applications; Data mining; Decision support systems; Learning algorithms; Prediction
keywords: data mining, decision support systems, market analysis, credit risk, marketing, fraud detection
rationale: The abstract discusses the use of data mining in various domains, including marketing, to enhance decision support systems. The focus on extracting interesting patterns and making informed decisions aligns well with the 'Thinking AI' category, particularly in market analysis and targeting. The emphasis on operational research and decision-making also supports this classification.
resumo: A mineração de dados envolve a extração de padrões interessantes a partir de dados e está no cerne da pesquisa operacional (RO), com o objetivo de criar e aprimorar sistemas de apoio à decisão. Desde os primeiros dias, algumas abordagens de mineração de dados se basearam em métodos tradicionais de RO, como programação linear e previsões, e os métodos modernos de mineração de dados são fundamentados em uma ampla variedade de métodos de RO, incluindo otimização linear e quadrática, algoritmos genéticos e conceitos baseados em colônias de formigas artificiais. O uso da mineração de dados se tornou rapidamente disseminado, com aplicações em áreas que vão desde risco de crédito, marketing e detecção de fraudes até contra-terrorismo. Em todos esses casos, a mineração de dados desempenha um papel cada vez mais importante na tomada de decisões. No entanto, muitos desafios ainda precisam ser enfrentados, desde questões de qualidade dos dados até o problema de como incluir o conhecimento de especialistas do domínio ou como monitorar o desempenho do modelo. Neste artigo, delineamos uma série de tendências e desafios futuros para a mineração de dados e seu papel dentro da RO.

Title: Auction Advisor: An agent-based online-auction decision support system
Authors: Gregg D.G.; Walczak S.
Abstract: Online auctions are proving themselves as a viable alternative in the C2C and B2C marketplace. Several thousand new items are placed for auction every day and determining which items to bid on or when and where to sell an item are difficult questions to answer for online-auction participants. This paper presents a multiagent Auction Advisor system designed to collect data related to online auctions and use the data to help improve the decision making of auction participants. A simulation of applied Auction Advisor recommendations and a small research study that used subjects making real purchases at online auctions both indicate that online-auction buyers and sellers achieve tangible benefit from the current information acquired by and recommendations made by the Auction Advisor agents. © 2004 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved.
Keywords: Autonomous agent; Data analysis; Decision support; Information retrieval; Online auction
keywords: online auctions, data collection, decision making, Auction Advisor, recommendations, marketplace
rationale: The abstract discusses a multiagent Auction Advisor system that collects data related to online auctions and provides recommendations to improve decision-making for auction participants. This aligns closely with the Mechanical AI category, which focuses on data collection and automated processes to enhance market understanding and decision-making. The emphasis on improving auction outcomes through collected data and recommendations fits well within the definitions of Mechanical AI, particularly in data collection and standardization.
resumo: Leilões online estão se mostrando uma alternativa viável no mercado C2C e B2C. Todos os dias, milhares de novos itens são leiloados, e determinar quais itens oferecer lances ou quando e onde vender um item são questões difíceis para os participantes. Este artigo apresenta um sistema de Consultor de Leilão multiagente projetado para coletar dados relacionados a leilões online e usar essas informações para melhorar a tomada de decisão dos participantes. Uma simulação das recomendações do Consultor de Leilão e um pequeno estudo de pesquisa com sujeitos realizando compras reais em leilões online indicam que compradores e vendedores de leilões online obtêm benefícios tangíveis das informações atuais adquiridas e das recomendações feitas pelos agentes do Consultor de Leilão. © 2004 Elsevier B.V. Todos os direitos reservados.

Title: From decision support to decision automation: A 2020 vision
Authors: Bucklin R.E.; Lehmann D.R.; Little J.D.C.
Abstract: The authors discuss the long-run future of decision support systems in marketing. They argue that a growing proportion of marketing decisions can not only be supported but may also be automated. From a standpoint of both efficiency (e.g., management productivity) and effectiveness (e.g., resource allocation decisions), such automation is highly desirable. The authors describe how model-based automated decision-making is likely to penetrate various marketing decision-making environments and how such models can incorporate competitive dynamics. For example, the authors foresee that close to full automation can ultimately take place for many decisions about existing products in stable markets. Partial automation could characterize decision making for new products in stable markets and existing products in unstable markets.
Keywords: Automation; Competition; Decision support
keywords: automation, decision support systems, model-based decision-making, efficiency, effectiveness
rationale: The abstract discusses the automation of marketing decisions and the use of model-based automated decision-making, which aligns with the focus on efficiency and the automation of processes, fitting into the Mechanical AI category. It emphasizes how marketing decisions, especially in stable markets, can be automated, which is a core aspect of data collection and standardization in Mechanical AI.
resumo: Os autores discutem o futuro a longo prazo dos sistemas de suporte à decisão em marketing, argumentando que uma proporção crescente das decisões de marketing pode não apenas ser apoiada, mas também automatizada. Do ponto de vista da eficiência (por exemplo, produtividade da gestão) e eficácia (por exemplo, decisões de alocação de recursos), tal automação é altamente desejável. Eles descrevem como a tomada de decisão automatizada baseada em modelos provavelmente penetrará em vários ambientes de tomada de decisão de marketing e como esses modelos podem incorporar dinâmicas competitivas. Por exemplo, os autores preveem que a automação quase total pode ocorrer para muitas decisões sobre produtos existentes em mercados estáveis. A automação parcial pode caracterizar a tomada de decisão para novos produtos em mercados estáveis e produtos existentes em mercados instáveis.

Title: Inventory forecasting with a multiple criteria decision tool
Authors: Korpela J.; Tuominen M.
Abstract: The strategic role of logistics is increasingly being recognised, and inventory strategy is an essential element of logistics strategy. Demand forecasting is one of the most crucial issues of inventory management as forecasts form the basis for the planning of production, transportation and inventory levels. The traditional methods used for forecasting include time series methods and causal methods. In the paper, we present an Analytic Hierarchy Process-based approach to demand forecasting. The proposed decision support system offers many improvements compared to traditional methods, such as the possibility to include both tangible and intangible factors in the forecasting process, and the ability to make predictions about the future development of the environmental factors.
Keywords: Analytic Hierarchy Process; Decision support systems; Demand Forecasting
keywords: demand forecasting, inventory management, decision support system, environmental factors, tangible and intangible factors
rationale: The abstract discusses an approach to demand forecasting, which is a strategic market analysis tool that helps in planning production, transportation, and inventory levels. The focus on improving forecasting methods aligns with the category of Thinking AI, particularly in market analysis and targeting, as it involves assessing both tangible and intangible factors in predicting future demand. The system presented supports strategic decision-making, which is characteristic of analytical processes used in marketing.
resumo: O papel estratégico da logística está sendo cada vez mais reconhecido, e a estratégia de inventário é um elemento essencial da estratégia logística. A previsão de demanda é uma das questões mais cruciais da gestão de inventário, pois as previsões formam a base para o planejamento da produção, transporte e níveis de estoque. Os métodos tradicionais utilizados para previsão incluem métodos de séries temporais e métodos causais. Neste artigo, apresentamos uma abordagem baseada no Processo de Análise Hierárquica para a previsão de demanda. O sistema de suporte à decisão proposto oferece muitas melhorias em comparação com os métodos tradicionais, como a possibilidade de incluir fatores tangíveis e intangíveis no processo de previsão e a capacidade de fazer previsões sobre o desenvolvimento futuro dos fatores ambientais.

Title: Knowledge-based systems for strategic market planning in small firms
Authors: Borch O.J.; Hartvigsen G.
Abstract: This paper gives an overview of strategic planning and decision-making in small firms, together with a discussion of the use of knowledge-based systems in strategic market planning. Furthermore, we describe the STRATEX system, which is a knowledge-based system for strategic market-planning in the export trade of fish and fisheries products. The results of the pilot system development of STRATEX are briefly presented, along with a discussion of needs for further developments in this field. © 1991.
Keywords: Artificial intelligence; Decision support systems; Expert systems; Fish industry; Knowledge-based systems; Market segments; Marketing; Strategic decision making; Strategic market planning
keywords: strategic planning, decision-making, knowledge-based systems, market planning, STRATEX system, export trade
rationale: The abstract discusses strategic planning and decision-making in small firms, and the use of knowledge-based systems for strategic market planning, which aligns with the market analysis and targeting focus of Thinking AI. The mention of the STRATEX system specifically indicates an application related to strategic market-planning, which is a key aspect of understanding competitors and competitive advantages.
resumo: Este artigo apresenta uma visão geral do planejamento estratégico e da tomada de decisões em pequenas empresas, além de discutir o uso de sistemas baseados em conhecimento no planejamento estratégico de mercado. Também descrevemos o sistema STRATEX, que é um sistema baseado em conhecimento para planejamento estratégico de mercado no comércio de exportação de peixes e produtos pesqueiros. Os resultados do desenvolvimento do sistema piloto do STRATEX são apresentados de forma breve, juntamente com uma discussão sobre as necessidades de novos desenvolvimentos nesta área. © 1991.

Title: A strategic framework for artificial intelligence in marketing
Authors: Huang M.-H.; Rust R.T.
Abstract: The authors develop a three-stage framework for strategic marketing planning, incorporating multiple artificial intelligence (AI) benefits: mechanical AI for automating repetitive marketing functions and activities, thinking AI for processing data to arrive at decisions, and feeling AI for analyzing interactions and human emotions. This framework lays out the ways that AI can be used for marketing research, strategy (segmentation, targeting, and positioning, STP), and actions. At the marketing research stage, mechanical AI can be used for data collection, thinking AI for market analysis, and feeling AI for customer understanding. At the marketing strategy (STP) stage, mechanical AI can be used for segmentation (segment recognition), thinking AI for targeting (segment recommendation), and feeling AI for positioning (segment resonance). At the marketing action stage, mechanical AI can be used for standardization, thinking AI for personalization, and feeling AI for relationalization. We apply this framework to various areas of marketing, organized by marketing 4Ps/4Cs, to illustrate the strategic use of AI. © 2020, The Author(s).
Keywords: 4Cs; 4Ps; Artificial intelligence; Feeling AI; Machine learning; Marketing strategy; Mechanical AI; Personalization; Positioning; Relationalization; Segmentation; Standardization; Strategic AI marketing; Targeting; Thinking AI
keywords: emotions, customer understanding, relationalization, positioning
rationale: The abstract outlines a framework that incorporates AI in several stages of marketing, specifically highlighting the role of feeling AI in analyzing interactions and human emotions. It emphasizes customer understanding, positioning, and relationalization, which directly align with the definitions provided for feeling AI. Additionally, while mechanical and thinking AI elements are present, the focus on emotional aspects indicates a stronger association with feeling AI.
resumo: Os autores desenvolvem um framework de três etapas para o planejamento estratégico de marketing, incorporando múltiplos benefícios da inteligência artificial (IA): IA mecânica para automatizar funções e atividades de marketing repetitivas, IA pensante para processar dados e tomar decisões, e IA emocional para analisar interações e emoções humanas. Este framework descreve como a IA pode ser utilizada na pesquisa de marketing, estratégia (segmentação, direcionamento e posicionamento, STP) e ações. Na etapa de pesquisa de marketing, a IA mecânica pode ser usada para coleta de dados, a IA pensante para análise de mercado e a IA emocional para compreensão do cliente. Na etapa de estratégia de marketing (STP), a IA mecânica pode ser utilizada para segmentação (reconhecimento de segmentos), a IA pensante para direcionamento (recomendação de segmentos) e a IA emocional para posicionamento (ressonância de segmentos). Na etapa de ação de marketing, a IA mecânica pode ser usada para padronização, a IA pensante para personalização e a IA emocional para relacionalização. Aplicamos este framework a várias áreas de marketing, organizadas pelos 4Ps/4Cs de marketing, para ilustrar o uso estratégico da IA.

Title: Optimising marketing strategies by customer segments and lifetime values, with a/b testing
Authors: Guha P.; Echagarruga C.; Tian E.Q.
Abstract: Every customer has different needs and purchasing behaviour. This paper shows how data science tools such as machine learning, artificial intelligence and A/B testing enable marketers to segment their target market, identify the most loyal high-value customers and their purchasing patterns, and calculate the lifetime value of these customer segments to optimise marketing strategies and campaigns. The paper also argues that A/B testing helps marketers make unbiased data-driven decisions, making it the gold standard for identifying the best marketing strategy. © Henry Stewart Publications 2054-7544 (2021).
Keywords: A/B testing; Customer; Experimentation; Lifetime value (LTV); Predictive analytics; Segmentation
keywords: data science, machine learning, A/B testing, segment, market, purchasing patterns, lifetime value, optimise marketing strategies, data-driven decisions
rationale: The abstract discusses the use of data science tools like machine learning and A/B testing to segment markets and identify customer behaviors, which aligns closely with the 'Thinking AI' category focused on market analysis and targeting. The emphasis on optimizing marketing strategies and making data-driven decisions further supports this classification.
resumo: Este artigo demonstra como ferramentas de ciência de dados, como aprendizado de máquina, inteligência artificial e testes A/B, permitem que os profissionais de marketing segmentem seu mercado-alvo, identifiquem os clientes mais leais e de alto valor e seus padrões de compra, além de calcular o valor vitalício desses segmentos de clientes para otimizar estratégias e campanhas de marketing. O artigo também argumenta que os testes A/B ajudam os profissionais de marketing a tomar decisões imparciais baseadas em dados, tornando-se o padrão de excelência para identificar a melhor estratégia de marketing.

Title: Segmentation Approach for Athleisure and Performance Sport Retailers Based on Data Mining Techniques
Authors: Rogić S.; Kašćelan L.
Abstract: This paper seeks to compare certain customer segments from two sport footwear, apparel, and equipment retailers and to examine an objective market segmentation method, based on the recency, frequency, monetary (RFM) and the decision tree (DT) models. The case study is based on two data sets, aiming to compare the different customer segments, both from sport retail industry, and represents an application of data mining techniques in a business environment. The customer segmentation enables the customer selection for the future direct marketing campaigns based on the previous purchasing behavior. Analyzing the customers’ purchasing history can help the company determine the value of each customer and therefore target or not target such customers in the future with promotional materials, based on both the customers’ interests and their value. Thus, based on the results, personalized offers can be created for each of the defined customer groups, which may increase the efficiency of the overall campaign, reduce costs, and increase profitability. resumo: Este artigo busca comparar certos segmentos de clientes de dois varejistas de calçados, vestuário e equipamentos esportivos e examinar um método objetivo de segmentação de mercado, baseado nos modelos de recência, frequência e valor monetário (RFM) e árvore de decisão (DT). O estudo de caso é baseado em dois conjuntos de dados, com o objetivo de comparar os diferentes segmentos de clientes, ambos da indústria de varejo esportivo, e representa uma aplicação de técnicas de mineração de dados em um ambiente de negócios. A segmentação de clientes permite a seleção de clientes para futuras campanhas de marketing direto, com base no comportamento de compra anterior. Assim, com base nos resultados, ofertas personalizadas podem ser criadas para cada um dos grupos de clientes definidos, o que pode aumentar a eficiência da campanha geral, reduzir custos e aumentar a lucratividade.
