The paper also discusses a framework for managing data in decision making. The topic must be addressed for taking better decisions for firms which will contribute to high quality knowledge. © Operations and Supply Chain Management. All rights reserved.
Keywords: Big data; Big data analytics; Marketing analytics; Social media analytics
Publisher: Operations and Supply Chain Management Forum
keywords: big data, decision making, competitive advantage, market analysis
rationale: The abstract emphasizes the role of big data in enhancing decision-making processes within business firms, focusing on market analysis and competitive advantages derived from data. It discusses how businesses can leverage large datasets to make smarter, real-time decisions, which aligns closely with the 'Thinking AI' category that focuses on market analysis and targeting.
resumo: Sistemas de informação associados à internet, computação em nuvem, dispositivos móveis e Internet das Coisas resultaram em volumes massivos de dados, comumente chamados de big data. Isso inclui uma mistura de dados estruturados, semi-estruturados e não estruturados em tempo real, que constituem armazéns de dados, OLAP, ETL e informações. Empresas e acadêmicos desenvolveram maneiras únicas de extrair valor do big data. Há um grande potencial para usar grandes conjuntos de dados como um insumo adicional para a tomada de decisões. O objetivo do artigo é explorar o papel do big data nessas áreas para melhorar a tomada de decisões. Aqui, examinamos como o big data pode ser utilizado para tomar decisões inteligentes e em tempo real para melhorar os resultados empresariais. O artigo realiza uma revisão da literatura e utiliza dados secundários para fornecer uma visão conceitual das oportunidades potenciais do big data na tomada de decisões. O artigo discute o conceito de big data, seu papel na tomada de decisões e também a vantagem competitiva do big data para diferentes empresas. Além disso, o artigo apresenta uma estrutura para gerenciar dados na tomada de decisões. O tema deve ser abordado para que as empresas possam tomar decisões melhores, contribuindo para um conhecimento de alta qualidade.

Title: Data-driven marketing for growth and profitability
Authors: Grandhi B.; Patwa N.; Saleem K.
Abstract: Purpose: In the current business environment, more uncertain than ever before, understanding consumer behavior is an integral part of an organization's strategic planning and execution process. It is the key driver for becoming a market leader. Therefore, it is important that all processes in business are customer centric. Marketers need to harness big data by engaging in data driven-marketing (DDM) to help organizations choose the “right” customers, to “keep” and “grow” them and to sustain “growth” and “profitability”. This research examines DDM adoption practices and how companies can aim to enhance shareholder value by bringing about “customer centricity”. Design/methodology/approach: An online survey conducted in 2016 received 180 responses from junior, middle and senior executives. Of the total responses, 26% were from senior management, 39% from middle management and the remaining 35% from junior management. Industries represented in the survey included retail, BFSI, healthcare and government, automobile, telecommunication, transport and logistics and IT. Other industries represented were aviation, marketing research and consulting, hospitality, advertising and media and human resource. Findings: Success of DDM depends upon how well an organization embraces the practice. The first and foremost indicator of an organization's commitment is the extent of resources invested for DDM. Respondents were divided into four categories; Laggards, Dabblers, Contenders and Leaders based on their “current level of investments” and “willingness to enhance investments” soon. Research limitations/implications: With storming digital age and the development of analytics, the process of decision-making has gained significant importance. Judgment and intuition too are critical to the process. Choosing an appropriate action cannot be done strictly on a rational basis. Practical implications: The results of the study offer interesting implications for managing the growing sea of data. An iterative and incremental approach is the need of the hour, even if it has to start with baby steps, to invest in and reap the fruits of DDM. The intention to use any system is always dependent on two primary belief factors: perceived usefulness and perceived ease of use; however, attitudes and social factors are equally important. Originality/value: There is a dearth of knowledge with regards to who is and is not adopting DDM, and how best big data can be harnessed for enhancing effectiveness and efficiency of marketing budget. It is, therefore, imperative to build a knowledge base on DDM practices, challenges and opportunities. Better use of data can help companies enhance shareholder value by bringing about “customer centricity”. © 2020, Emerald Publishing Limited.
Keywords: Customer centric; Data-driven marketing; Digital data; Digital marketing and marketing investment; Marketing analytics; Marketing dashboard; Marketing metrics; ROMI (return on marketing investment) and diffusion of innovation; Value proposition
keywords: consumer behavior, data driven-marketing, customer centricity, big data, market leader, shareholder value, strategic planning, investment, analytics
rationale: The abstract discusses the importance of understanding consumer behavior and the strategic implementation of data-driven marketing (DDM) to enhance shareholder value and customer centricity. It emphasizes market analysis, decision-making processes, and the investment in resources for DDM, which aligns well with the focus of Thinking AI on market analysis, targeting, and the use of analytics for competitive advantages.
resumo: O propósito deste estudo é entender o comportamento do consumidor como parte integral do planejamento estratégico das organizações em um ambiente de negócios incerto. A pesquisa analisa as práticas de adoção de marketing orientado por dados (DDM) e como as empresas podem aumentar o valor para os acionistas ao se tornarem centradas no cliente. Uma pesquisa online realizada em 2016 com 180 executivos revelou que o sucesso do DDM depende do comprometimento da organização e dos recursos investidos. Os respondentes foram classificados em quatro categorias: Laggards, Dabblers, Contenders e Leaders, com base em seus níveis de investimento. A pesquisa destaca a importância de uma abordagem iterativa e incremental para gerenciar grandes volumes de dados e sugere que a intenção de usar sistemas depende da percepção de utilidade e facilidade de uso, além de fatores sociais. Há uma falta de conhecimento sobre a adoção do DDM e como melhor utilizar os dados para otimizar o orçamento de marketing. Portanto, é essencial construir uma base de conhecimento sobre as práticas, desafios e oportunidades do DDM. O uso eficaz dos dados pode ajudar as empresas a aumentar o valor para os acionistas ao se tornarem centradas no cliente.

Title: Marketing analytics capability, artificial intelligence adoption, and firms? competitive advantage: Evidence from the manufacturing industry
Authors: Hossain, MA; Agnihotri, R; Rushan, MRI; Rahman, MS; Sumi, SF
Abstract: Data-driven analytics and artificial intelligence (AI) have become the most crucial aspects of today's industrial marketing management. Although many firms have embraced analytics and AI strategies, corresponding academic advances have been slow. This research investigates how industrial goods manufacturers sustain their competitive advantage in export markets, convincing buyers in a competitive data-rich business environment. The evidence has been taken from the RMG (readymade garment) industry, one of the largest manufacturing industries significantly attached to the export markets. Utilizing multi-phase research design, the study reveals that firms marketing analytics capability play a vital role in sensing, seizing, and reconfiguring the market, consequently leading to a sustained competitive advantage. The performance of sensing, seizing, and reconfiguring becomes higher for a firm when they adopt AI on the strength of the marketing analytics platform. These findings exhibit the latest avenue of exploration within marketing analytics and AI's academic research paradigm. Further, in practice, managers will be aware of the facts that create resilience in this specific industry context.
Keywords: Marketing analytics capability; AI adoption; Market sensing; Market seizing; Market reconfiguration; Manufacturing industry; B2B export market
keywords: marketing analytics, competitive advantage, data-rich business environment, sensing, seizing, reconfiguring
rationale: The abstract discusses the role of marketing analytics and AI in sustaining competitive advantage, particularly in the context of the RMG industry. It emphasizes the importance of analyzing market conditions and leveraging data to enhance performance, which aligns closely with the definition of Thinking AI focused on market analysis and identifying competitive advantages.
resumo: A análise orientada por dados e a inteligência artificial (IA) tornaram-se aspectos cruciais na gestão de marketing industrial atual. Embora muitas empresas tenham adotado estratégias de análise e IA, os avanços acadêmicos correspondentes têm sido lentos. Esta pesquisa investiga como os fabricantes de bens industriais mantêm sua vantagem competitiva em mercados de exportação, convencendo compradores em um ambiente de negócios competitivo e rico em dados. As evidências foram coletadas da indústria de roupas prontas (RMG), uma das maiores indústrias de manufatura fortemente ligada aos mercados de exportação. Utilizando um design de pesquisa em múltiplas fases, o estudo revela que a capacidade de análise de marketing das empresas desempenha um papel vital na percepção, aproveitamento e reconfiguração do mercado, levando a uma vantagem competitiva sustentada. O desempenho na percepção, aproveitamento e reconfiguração é maior para uma empresa quando ela adota IA com base na plataforma de análise de marketing. Essas descobertas apresentam uma nova área de exploração dentro do paradigma de pesquisa acadêmica em análise de marketing e IA. Além disso, na prática, os gerentes estarão cientes dos fatores que criam resiliência nesse contexto específico da indústria.

Title: Machine learning and artificial intelligence use in marketing: a general taxonomy
Authors: De Mauro A.; Sestino A.; Bacconi A.
Abstract: The emergence of consumer-generated data and the growing availability of Machine Learning (ML) techniques are revolutionizing marketing practices. Marketers and researchers are far from having a thorough understanding of the broad range of opportunities ML applications offer in creating and maintaining a competitive business advantage. In this paper, we propose a taxonomy of ML use cases in marketing based on a systematic review of academic and business literature. We have identified 11 recurring use cases, organized in 4 homogeneous families which correspond to the fundamentals leverage areas of ML in marketing, namely: shopper fundamentals, consumption experience, decision making, and financial impact. We discuss the recurring patterns identified in the taxonomy and provide a conceptual framework for its interpretation and extension, highlighting practical implications for marketers and researchers. © The Author(s) 2022.
Keywords: Analytics; Artificial intelligence; Big Data; Machine learning; Marketing; Marketing analytics
keywords: Machine Learning, taxonomy, use cases, market advantage, decision making, financial impact
rationale: The abstract discusses the use of Machine Learning (ML) in marketing, focusing on various applications that enhance decision making, analysis of consumption experiences, and financial impacts. The identification of use cases and their organization into families aligns with strategic analysis in marketing, which corresponds to the Thinking AI category.
resumo: A emergência de dados gerados por consumidores e a crescente disponibilidade de técnicas de Aprendizado de Máquina (ML) estão revolucionando as práticas de marketing. Os profissionais de marketing e pesquisadores ainda não compreendem completamente a ampla gama de oportunidades que as aplicações de ML oferecem para criar e manter uma vantagem competitiva nos negócios. Neste artigo, propomos uma taxonomia de casos de uso de ML em marketing com base em uma revisão sistemática da literatura acadêmica e empresarial. Identificamos 11 casos de uso recorrentes, organizados em 4 famílias homogêneas que correspondem às áreas fundamentais de alavancagem de ML em marketing: fundamentos do comprador, experiência de consumo, tomada de decisão e impacto financeiro. Discutimos os padrões recorrentes identificados na taxonomia e fornecemos um quadro conceitual para sua interpretação e extensão, destacando implicações práticas para profissionais de marketing e pesquisadores.

Title: Does marketing analytics capability boost firms' competitive marketing performance in data-rich business environment?
Authors: Rahman M.S.; Hossain M.A.; Abdel Fattah F.A.M.
Abstract: Purpose: Few well-documented studies have explained the importance of researching firms' marketing analytics capability (FMAC). In spite of its significance, there is scant attention to conceptualising and empirically investigating FMAC and its consequences in a data-driven business context. Thus, this study aims to develop and test a conceptual model that relates FMAC and its repercussions in the data-rich business environment. Design/methodology/approach: This study analysed the data from 250 managers amongst large and medium-sized manufacturing and service-intensive firms. Furthermore, this research performed an empirical study by using operationalised questionnaire survey method to verify the hypotheses and reach its theoretical and managerial implications. Structural equation modelling with maximum-likelihood estimation method was applied to verify the validity of the proposed research model. Findings: Multivariate analysis results show that FMAC significantly influences firms' competitive marketing performance (FCMP) with the presence of holistic marketing decision-making (HMDM) as a mediator. Moreover, adoption of artificial intelligence (AAI) enhances the relationship of FMAC-HMDM and FMAC-FCMP linkages. Practical implications: This study analyses how FMAC can enhance FCMP and contributes to resource-based views and technological capability theories. From a managerial perspective, guidelines are provided for marketers to adopt advance technologies, such as AI, to optimise FMAC and HMDM to achieve competitive marketing performance. Originality/value: Believing that “how to be competitive in marketing performance under data-rich-environment”, this research is the first to use the data of a firm manager to facilitate the understanding of FMAC, which provides a new direction for improving marketing performance. In addition, HMDM and AAI are also proposed for firms to optimise FCMP. © 2021, Emerald Publishing Limited.
Keywords: Artificial intelligence; Competitive marketing performance; Holistic marketing decision; Marketing analytics capability
keywords: marketing analytics capability, competitive marketing performance, holistic marketing decision-making, adoption of artificial intelligence, empirical study
rationale: The abstract discusses the relationship between firms' marketing analytics capability (FMAC) and their competitive marketing performance (FCMP), emphasizing the importance of market analysis and decision-making in a data-driven environment. The mention of using artificial intelligence to enhance these relationships further aligns with the strategic analysis focus of Thinking AI.
resumo: Este estudo investiga a capacidade de análise de marketing das empresas (FMAC) e suas repercussões em um ambiente de negócios rico em dados. A pesquisa analisou dados de 250 gerentes de empresas de médio e grande porte nos setores de manufatura e serviços. Utilizando um questionário operacionalizado, o estudo verificou hipóteses e implicações teóricas e gerenciais, aplicando modelagem de equações estruturais. Os resultados mostram que a FMAC influencia significativamente o desempenho competitivo de marketing das empresas (FCMP), mediado pela tomada de decisão de marketing holística (HMDM). Além disso, a adoção de inteligência artificial (AAI) fortalece a relação entre FMAC-HMDM e FMAC-FCMP. O estudo oferece diretrizes para que os profissionais de marketing adotem tecnologias avançadas, como IA, para otimizar FMAC e HMDM, visando melhorar o desempenho de marketing competitivo. Esta pesquisa é pioneira ao utilizar dados de gerentes para compreender a FMAC, propondo novas direções para aprimorar o desempenho de marketing.

Title: Unveiling user responses to AI-powered personalised recommendations: a qualitative study of consumer engagement dynamics on Douyin
Authors: Ding L.; Antonucci G.; Venditti M.
Abstract: Purpose: This study aims to explore the impact of artificial intelligence-powered personalised recommendations (AI-PPRs) on user engagement, browsing behaviour and purchase intentions on TikTok (Douyin in China), focusing on how these recommendations affect user satisfaction and purchase intention, while also addressing potential privacy concerns. In addition, the research investigates the influence of AI-recommended product presentation, timing and placement, as well as social factors such as key opinion leaders’ (KOLs) influence on consumer decision-making. Design/methodology/approach: Using the expectancy-value theory and the stimulus-organism-response model, this research used a qualitative methodology through interviews with Douyin users to explore their experiences and perceptions of AI-PPRs. Findings: The findings indicate that Douyin’s proactive “push” mechanism of AI-PPRs enhances user engagement by effortlessly integrating product discovery into the entertainment experience. Content-driven AI-PPRs align with user preferences, decrease search time and increase satisfaction and purchase intentions through engaging short videos and live streaming. However, privacy concerns emerge when personalisation is perceived as excessively intrusive, leading to negative emotions and avoidance behaviours. Recommendation timing and cultural context significantly influence receptiveness, with inappropriate timing (e.g. during holidays) causing negative reactions. Technical challenges, such as network issues during live streaming, negatively impact user experience and engagement. Content quality is crucial, and poor or irrelevant content leads to negative perceptions and disengagement. While KOLs face scepticism due to perceived commercialisation, endorsements from trusted figures and authentic influencers are better received. Innovative payment methods, like “Douyin Monthly Payment”, enhance financial flexibility and promote customer loyalty. This study highlights the need to balance personalisation with privacy, emphasising the importance of content quality and authenticity in influencer marketing. For businesses using AI-PPRs, maintaining this balance is essential for preserving trust and sustaining consumer engagement and loyalty. Originality/value: This study contributes valuable insights to the field by unravelling the intricate dynamics between AI-PPRs, user preferences and social influences. The findings provide practical implications for companies aiming to optimise personalised recommendation algorithms and enhance user engagement, thereby facilitating business growth in the dynamic short video e-commerce market. © 2024, Emerald Publishing Limited.
Keywords: Artificial intelligence; China; Consumer behaviour; Douyin; E-commerce; KOL; Live streaming; Personalised recommendations; Qualitative research; Short video; TikTok
keywords: personalised recommendations, user engagement, purchase intentions, user satisfaction, influence of KOLs, market analysis, customer preferences
rationale: The abstract focuses heavily on the personalization of recommendations using AI to enhance user engagement and purchase intentions. It discusses the strategic analysis of how AI-PPRs influence consumer behavior through various factors such as product presentation, timing, and the impact of key opinion leaders. The emphasis on understanding user preferences and tailoring experiences aligns closely with the definitions of Thinking AI, which emphasizes market analysis and personalization based on customer preferences.
resumo: Este estudo tem como objetivo explorar o impacto das recomendações personalizadas impulsionadas por inteligência artificial (AI-PPRs) no engajamento do usuário, comportamento de navegação e intenções de compra no TikTok (Douyin na China), focando em como essas recomendações afetam a satisfação do usuário e a intenção de compra, além de abordar preocupações potenciais com a privacidade. A pesquisa investiga também a influência da apresentação, tempo e posicionamento dos produtos recomendados pela IA, assim como fatores sociais, como a influência de líderes de opinião (KOLs) na tomada de decisão do consumidor. Utilizando a teoria da expectativa-valor e o modelo estímulo-organismo-resposta, a pesquisa adotou uma metodologia qualitativa por meio de entrevistas com usuários do Douyin para explorar suas experiências e percepções sobre as AI-PPRs. Os resultados indicam que o mecanismo proativo de "push" das AI-PPRs do Douyin melhora o engajamento do usuário ao integrar de forma fluida a descoberta de produtos na experiência de entretenimento. As AI-PPRs orientadas por conteúdo alinham-se às preferências dos usuários, diminuem o tempo de busca e aumentam a satisfação e as intenções de compra por meio de vídeos curtos envolventes e transmissões ao vivo. No entanto, surgem preocupações com a privacidade quando a personalização é percebida como excessivamente intrusiva, levando a emoções negativas e comportamentos de evitação. O tempo das recomendações e o contexto cultural influenciam significativamente a receptividade, com momentos inadequados (por exemplo, durante feriados) causando reações negativas. Desafios técnicos, como problemas de rede durante transmissões ao vivo, impactam negativamente a experiência e o engajamento do usuário. A qualidade do conteúdo é crucial, e conteúdos ruins ou irrelevantes levam a percepções negativas e desengajamento. Embora os KOLs enfrentem ceticismo devido à comercialização percebida, endossos de figuras confiáveis e influenciadores autênticos são melhor recebidos. Métodos de pagamento inovadores, como o "Pagamento Mensal do Douyin", aumentam a flexibilidade financeira e promovem a lealdade do cliente. Este estudo destaca a necessidade de equilibrar personalização com privacidade, enfatizando a importância da qualidade do conteúdo e da autenticidade no marketing de influenciadores. Para as empresas que utilizam AI-PPRs, manter esse equilíbrio é essencial para preservar a confiança e sustentar o engajamento e a lealdade do consumidor. Este estudo contribui com insights valiosos ao desvendar as dinâmicas complexas entre AI-PPRs, preferências dos usuários e influências sociais, oferecendo implicações práticas para empresas que buscam otimizar algoritmos de recomendação personalizada e aumentar o engajamento do usuário, facilitando assim o crescimento nos dinâmicos mercados de e-commerce de vídeos curtos.

Title: The influence of Covid-19 on consumer behaviour: a bibliometric review analysis and text mining
Authors: Bashar A.; Nyagadza B.; Ligaraba N.; Maziriri E.T.
Abstract: Purpose: This paper is a bibliometric analysis of articles published on the influence of Covid-19 on consumer behaviour. Design/methodology/approach: Biblioshiny and VOSviewer applications are employed for the bibliometric analysis and visualisation, respectively. Findings: The most influential documents, authors, affiliations, countries and journals are presented. Citation, Co-citation and keyword co-occurrence analysis is conducted and presented in the form of a clustered network diagram. Practical implications: This paper found three main themes of the research in consumer behaviour amid Covid-19 a) Food purchasing decisions and food wastage, b) Adoption of technology and c) Intrinsic and extrinsic influence on consumer behaviour. Social implications: The Covid-19 pandemic has shaken the world’s economy and left behind its adverse effect on almost every walk of life. Consumer behaviour is no exception, studies have reported paradigm shifts in the way consumers are reacting to marketing stimuli, making purchase and consumption decisions. For the marketers to sustain profitability, they need to understand the changing behaviour and tailor their offerings accordingly. Originality/value: The article offers the emerging theme and sub-themes in the consumer behaviour research that leads to future expansion of this research domain. © 2023, Abu Bashar, Brighton Nyagadza, Neo Ligaraba and Eugine Tafadzwa Maziriri.
Keywords: Bibliometric analysis; Biblioshiny; Consumer behaviours; Covid-19; VOSviewer
keywords: consumer behaviour, Covid-19, market analysis, adoption of technology, food purchasing decisions
rationale: The abstract discusses a bibliometric analysis of consumer behaviour during Covid-19, highlighting themes such as food purchasing decisions and the adoption of technology. This aligns with the Thinking AI category, which focuses on market analysis and understanding competitive advantages. The analysis aims to provide insights into changing consumer behaviour, which marketers can use for strategic decision-making.
resumo: Este artigo é uma análise bibliométrica de artigos publicados sobre a influência da Covid-19 no comportamento do consumidor. Foram utilizadas as aplicações Biblioshiny e VOSviewer para a análise bibliométrica e visualização, respectivamente. Os documentos, autores, afiliações, países e periódicos mais influentes são apresentados. A análise de citação, co-citação e coocorrência de palavras-chave é realizada e apresentada na forma de um diagrama de rede agrupada. O estudo identificou três temas principais na pesquisa sobre comportamento do consumidor durante a Covid-19: a) Decisões de compra de alimentos e desperdício de alimentos, b) Adoção de tecnologia e c) Influência intrínseca e extrínseca no comportamento do consumidor. A pandemia de Covid-19 abalou a economia mundial e deixou efeitos adversos em quase todos os aspectos da vida. O comportamento do consumidor não é exceção, com estudos relatando mudanças de paradigma na forma como os consumidores reagem a estímulos de marketing, tomando decisões de compra e consumo. Para que os profissionais de marketing mantenham a lucratividade, é necessário entender o comportamento em mudança e adaptar suas ofertas de acordo. O artigo oferece temas emergentes e subtemas na pesquisa sobre comportamento do consumidor, que levam à futura expansão deste domínio de pesquisa.

Title: Is mandatory seller disclosure of flood risk necessary? A Brisbane, Australia, case study
Authors: Brown C.; Christensen S.; Blake A.; Indraswari K.; Wilson C.; Desouza K.
Abstract: Purpose: Information on the impact of flooding is fundamental to mitigating flood risk in residential property. This paper aims to provide insight into the seller disclosure of flood risk and buyer behaviour in the absence of mandated seller disclosure. Design/methodology/approach: This paper adopts a case study approach to critically evaluate the matrix of flood information available for buyers purchasing residential property in Brisbane, Queensland. This paper uses big data analytic techniques to extract and analyse internet data from online seller agents and buyer platforms to gain an understanding of buyer awareness and consideration of flood risk in the residential property market. Findings: Analysis of property marketing data demonstrates that seller agents voluntarily disclose flood impact only in periods where a flooding event is anticipated and is limited to asserting a property is free of flood risk. Analysis of buyer commentary demonstrates that buyers are either unaware of flood information or are discounting the risk of flood in favour of other property and locational attributes when selecting residential property. Practical implications: This research suggests that improved and accessible government-provided flood mapping tools are not enhancing buyers’ understanding and awareness of flood risk. Accordingly, it is recommended that mandatory disclosure be introduced in Queensland so that buyers are more able to manage risk and investment decisions before the purchase of residential property. Originality/value: This paper contributes to existing literature on raising community awareness and understanding of natural disaster risks and makes a further contribution in identifying mandatory disclosure as a mechanism to highlight the risk of flooding and inform residential property purchasers. © 2023, Emerald Publishing Limited.
Keywords: Community resilience; Consumer behaviour; Disaster management; Flood risk; Natural hazard
keywords: flood risk, buyer behaviour, seller disclosure, market analysis, government-provided flood mapping
rationale: The abstract discusses the impact of flooding on residential property markets and emphasizes the need for mandatory seller disclosures to enhance buyer awareness and understanding of flood risks. This aligns closely with the 'Thinking AI' category, as it involves market analysis and the need for strategic recommendations to improve buyer decision-making. The focus on understanding buyer behaviour and the effectiveness of current flood information dissemination further supports this classification.
resumo: O objetivo deste artigo é fornecer informações sobre a divulgação do risco de inundação pelos vendedores e o comportamento dos compradores na ausência de uma divulgação obrigatória. Utilizando uma abordagem de estudo de caso, o artigo avalia criticamente as informações sobre inundações disponíveis para compradores de imóveis residenciais em Brisbane, Queensland. A análise de dados de marketing imobiliário mostra que os agentes de venda divulgam voluntariamente o impacto das inundações apenas em períodos de eventos de inundação esperados, limitando-se a afirmar que um imóvel está livre de risco de inundação. Comentários de compradores indicam que eles estão, muitas vezes, desinformados sobre as inundações ou desconsideram esse risco em favor de outras características do imóvel e da localização. O estudo sugere que ferramentas de mapeamento de inundações fornecidas pelo governo não estão melhorando a compreensão dos compradores sobre o risco de inundação. Recomenda-se a introdução de uma divulgação obrigatória em Queensland para que os compradores possam gerenciar melhor os riscos e as decisões de investimento antes da compra de imóveis residenciais. Este artigo contribui para a literatura existente sobre a conscientização da comunidade sobre riscos de desastres naturais e identifica a divulgação obrigatória como um mecanismo para destacar o risco de inundação e informar os compradores de imóveis residenciais.

Title: An integrated model for predicting consumer's intention to write online reviews
Authors: Dixit S.; Jyoti Badgaiyan A.; Khare A.
Abstract: For marketers, consumers’ increasing use of online reviews in arriving at purchase decisions is a double edged sword. On one hand, it presents opportunity for manufacturers and sellers to be highlighted for their good work, but at the same time, there remains a possibility of negative review impacting goodwill and reputation. Hence, it is important for managers to identify factors that impact consumers’ intentions to write online reviews. This research delves into this aspect by trying to identify the factors that impact reviews writing intentions of consumers for restaurants. The study extends the theory of planned behaviour with additions of variables such as ego involvement, taking vengeance and helping a restaurant. For this, 252 valid responses were obtained, and structural equation modeling was used to test the proposed model. Results indicate that perceived behavioural control, subjective norms, ego involvement and taking vengeance are significant predictors of intention to write online reviews for the restaurants. © 2017 Elsevier Ltd
Keywords: Consumer behaviour; E-WOM; Intentions to write online reviews; Theory of planned behaviour
keywords: online reviews, consumer intentions, ego involvement, helping a restaurant, taking vengeance
rationale: The abstract discusses factors that influence consumers' intentions to write online reviews, which directly relates to understanding customer emotions and motivations. The inclusion of variables such as ego involvement and helping a restaurant indicates a focus on understanding emotional needs and relational aspects of consumer behavior, thus aligning with the Feeling AI category. Additionally, the study aims to understand and meet customer emotional needs regarding their review behaviors.
resumo: Para os profissionais de marketing, o crescente uso de avaliações online pelos consumidores na tomada de decisões de compra é uma faca de dois gumes. Por um lado, isso oferece oportunidades para fabricantes e vendedores serem destacados por seu bom trabalho, mas, ao mesmo tempo, existe a possibilidade de que avaliações negativas afetem a boa vontade e a reputação. Portanto, é importante que os gerentes identifiquem os fatores que influenciam as intenções dos consumidores de escrever avaliações online. Esta pesquisa investiga esse aspecto ao tentar identificar os fatores que impactam as intenções de escrita de avaliações dos consumidores para restaurantes. O estudo amplia a teoria do comportamento planejado com a adição de variáveis como envolvimento do ego, desejo de vingança e ajuda a um restaurante. Para isso, foram obtidas 252 respostas válidas, e a modelagem de equações estruturais foi utilizada para testar o modelo proposto. Os resultados indicam que o controle comportamental percebido, as normas subjetivas, o envolvimento do ego e o desejo de vingança são preditores significativos da intenção de escrever avaliações online para restaurantes.

Title: A varietal-specific approach to investigate wine risk perception in South Africa: Recommendations for Chenin blanc
Authors: Van der Colff N.; Pentz C.; Nieuwoudt H.
Abstract: Purpose: This study aims to describe South African consumers’ wine risk perception on varietal level with recommendations for Chenin blanc. Design/methodology/approach: An exploratory mixed methods approach was followed where qualitative data were used to develop the questionnaire. Quantitative data were collected from 2,051 respondents using an online survey. ANOVA and Fischer least significance difference tests were used to indicate statistical significance. Findings: Significant perceived risks (PRs) associated with Chenin blanc across age and ethnic groups were functional, time and financial risks. Risk-reducing strategies (RRS) in the white wine category were favourite brands and a trusted store, while Sauvignon blanc was also described as an RRS. Recommended Chenin blanc RRS include tastings and events with food. Research limitations/implications: Measurement of PR remains challenging. This research approach can be reproduced and/or adapted to investigate other struggling varietals and/or regions-of-origin. The convenience sample limits generalisability. Practical implications: Segments were identified to develop new markets for Chenin blanc. RRS emphasise the importance of real sensory experience rather than media exposure to build knowledge and familiarity. Originality/value: This study is a pioneering endeavour in terms of using an exploratory mixed methods research approach to investigate and describe risk perception of a specific wine varietal. Recommendations, with implications for strategic marketing decisions, are made for South African Chenin blanc. © 2019, Emerald Publishing Limited.
Keywords: Chenin blanc; Consumer behaviour; Consumer risk perception; Risk perception; South African white wine; Varietal perceived risk scale
keywords: risk perception, customer understanding, tastings, events, sensory experience, trusted store
rationale: The abstract discusses consumer risk perception concerning Chenin blanc, which relates to understanding customer needs and wants. It emphasizes the importance of sensory experiences and interaction with the product, aligning with the objectives of Feeling AI to develop customer understanding and emotional connections. Additionally, the research recommends strategies aimed at enhancing consumer experience, indicating a focus on relationalization. The findings also highlight the need to tailor marketing efforts based on emotional factors, further solidifying its placement in the Feeling AI category.
resumo: Este estudo tem como objetivo descrever a percepção de risco dos consumidores sul-africanos em relação ao vinho no nível varietal, com recomendações para o Chenin blanc. Foi adotada uma abordagem mista exploratória, utilizando dados qualitativos para desenvolver o questionário e coletando dados quantitativos de 2.051 respondentes por meio de uma pesquisa online. Os testes ANOVA e Fischer foram usados para indicar significância estatística. Os riscos percebidos significativos associados ao Chenin blanc, entre diferentes faixas etárias e grupos étnicos, foram riscos funcionais, de tempo e financeiros. As estratégias de redução de risco na categoria de vinhos brancos incluíram marcas favoritas e lojas de confiança, enquanto o Sauvignon blanc também foi descrito como uma estratégia de redução de risco. As recomendações para o Chenin blanc incluem degustações e eventos com comida. As limitações da pesquisa incluem a dificuldade na medição do risco percebido e a amostra de conveniência, que limita a generalização dos resultados. As implicações práticas indicam segmentos identificados para desenvolver novos mercados para o Chenin blanc, enfatizando a importância da experiência sensorial real em vez da exposição à mídia para construir conhecimento e familiaridade. Este estudo é pioneiro ao utilizar uma abordagem de pesquisa mista exploratória para investigar e descrever a percepção de risco de um varietal específico de vinho, com recomendações que têm implicações para decisões estratégicas de marketing para o Chenin blanc sul-africano.

Title: Toward a model of sparkling wine purchasing preferences
Authors: Verdonk N.; Wilkinson J.; Culbert J.; Ristic R.; Pearce K.; Wilkinson K.
Abstract: Purpose: This paper aims to provide further insight into factors influencing Australian consumers’ purchasing preferences for sparkling wine, including champagne. Design/methodology/approach: Focus groups were conducted and thematic analysis was undertaken to identify factors influencing sparkling wine consumers’ purchasing preferences. Findings: Personal taste was found to influence choice of a sparkling wine rather than another type of beverage, and selection of a particular style and brand of sparkling wine. Country or region of origin was found to be important, often linked to the product being champagne. Brand image, reputation and symbolism were found to influence purchase decisions (sometimes linked to consumption occasion), especially for purchases of gifts. Advice, recommendations and expert reviews, and consumption occasion also were found to influence purchase decisions. Price was found to influence style and brand of sparkling wine purchased. A high price was found to be a barrier for some participants, while other participants were found to avoid sparkling wines priced below some particular level. Thematic analysis enabled development of a preliminary model of purchasing preferences. Research limitations/implications: Being exploratory in nature, findings cannot be generalised. Further studies are required to confirm the preliminary model and to evaluate the validity and significance of proposed relationships. Practical implications: Findings suggest a producer could benefit from marketing a range of sparkling wines to cater to different tastes, occasions and gift purchases. Findings also confirm the importance of marketers pursuing opportunities to obtain and promote favourable expert reviews for their sparkling wines, and of identifying and promoting regional distinctiveness. Originality/value: The first comprehensive model of sparkling wine consumers’ purchasing preferences has been developed. Empirical testing would enable refinement and enhance understanding. © 2017, © Emerald Publishing Limited.
Keywords: Australia; Consumer behaviour; Psychometric/qualitative; Survey research; Wines
keywords: personal taste, brand image, reputation, consumption occasion, gift purchases, expert reviews, customer preferences
rationale: The abstract discusses various factors influencing purchasing preferences for sparkling wine, which includes understanding customer emotional needs and preferences such as personal taste, brand image, and the significance of the consumption occasion. These factors relate closely to customer understanding and positioning, which are key aspects of Feeling AI. The mention of gift purchases also ties into emotional engagement with customers. While there are elements that could relate to Mechanical or Thinking AI, the predominant focus on emotional and personal factors aligns it more closely with Feeling AI.
resumo: Este artigo tem como objetivo fornecer uma visão mais aprofundada sobre os fatores que influenciam as preferências de compra dos consumidores australianos em relação ao vinho espumante, incluindo o champanhe. Foram realizadas discussões em grupos focais e uma análise temática para identificar os fatores que influenciam as preferências de compra dos consumidores de vinho espumante. Os resultados mostraram que o gosto pessoal influencia a escolha de um vinho espumante em vez de outra bebida, assim como a seleção de um estilo e marca específicos. O país ou região de origem foi considerado importante, frequentemente associado ao produto ser champanhe. A imagem da marca, a reputação e o simbolismo também influenciam as decisões de compra, especialmente em compras de presentes. Recomendações e avaliações de especialistas, assim como a ocasião de consumo, também impactam as decisões de compra. O preço afeta o estilo e a marca do vinho espumante adquirido, com um preço elevado sendo uma barreira para alguns participantes, enquanto outros evitam vinhos espumantes com preços abaixo de um determinado nível. A análise temática possibilitou o desenvolvimento de um modelo preliminar de preferências de compra. As limitações da pesquisa indicam que, por ser exploratória, os resultados não podem ser generalizados, sendo necessárias mais investigações para confirmar o modelo preliminar e avaliar a validade e significância das relações propostas. As implicações práticas sugerem que os produtores poderiam se beneficiar ao comercializar uma variedade de vinhos espumantes para atender a diferentes gostos, ocasiões e compras de presentes, além de destacar a importância de obter e promover avaliações favoráveis de especialistas. O artigo apresenta o primeiro modelo abrangente das preferências de compra dos consumidores de vinho espumante, cuja testagem empírica permitiria um aprimoramento e uma melhor compreensão.

Title: Predicting consumer healthy choices regarding type 1 wheat flour
Authors: Fiore M.; Gallo C.; Tsoukatos E.; La Sala P.
Abstract: Purpose: Healthy and safety food issues are more and more becoming the purchasing process core of conscious consumer. “Type 1” wheat flour means higher protein and ash content. The purpose of this paper is to investigate the attributes usually referred to the characteristics of wheat flour known to consumers and at implementing a predictive model of purchasing that allows to make correct decisions without the necessary experience of a real human expert. Design/methodology/approach: In order to investigate the research aims of the paper, an online survey was carried out and conducted by means of the Google Forms in the detection time January-April 2016. The online survey collected responses from 467 Italian respondents asked to give feedback about their buying habits of various types of flour. The responses were analyzed through a data mining approach. This paper implements predictive analytics to create a statistical model of future behavior by means of a machine learning algorithms. Findings: In line with recent healthy and dynamic trends in the food industry, conscious consumer seems to be willing to pay a price for “type 1” wheat flour that is four times higher than the price related to the basic types of wheat flour. Social implications: Consumer seems not to know well the “type 1” wheat flour and its healthy characteristics; then, it should be crucial to implement promotional strategies and marketing hand in hand. Promotion can be a key element in putting across the health benefits of special kinds of wheat flour. Originality/value: Highlighting health issues about the “type 1” wheat flour gives insights and sheds some light on the crucial need of changing eating and purchasing behavior. Then, originality of this paper can be found in the used predictive algorithm of the artificial intelligence. © 2017, © Emerald Publishing Limited.
Keywords: Basis types of wheat flour; Consumer behaviour; Healthy food; Machine learning algorithms
keywords: predictive model, purchasing behavior, consumer feedback, marketing strategies, health benefits
rationale: The abstract discusses the implementation of a predictive model using machine learning algorithms to analyze consumer behavior related to 'type 1' wheat flour. This aligns with the Thinking AI category, which focuses on market analysis and using analytics to understand consumer preferences and behaviors. The emphasis on creating a statistical model for future purchasing behavior further supports this classification.
resumo: O objetivo deste artigo é investigar as características da farinha de trigo "tipo 1", que possui maior teor de proteínas e cinzas, e implementar um modelo preditivo de compra para ajudar consumidores a tomar decisões corretas sem a necessidade de experiência de um especialista. Para isso, foi realizada uma pesquisa online com 467 italianos sobre seus hábitos de compra de diferentes tipos de farinha, cujas respostas foram analisadas por meio de mineração de dados. Os resultados mostram que os consumidores estão dispostos a pagar um preço quatro vezes maior pela farinha "tipo 1" em comparação com tipos básicos. No entanto, muitos consumidores não conhecem bem as características saudáveis dessa farinha, o que indica a necessidade de estratégias promocionais e de marketing para destacar seus benefícios à saúde. A originalidade do artigo reside no uso de algoritmos preditivos de inteligência artificial para entender e mudar o comportamento de compra e alimentação.

Title: Attitude toward smoking: The effect of negative smoking-related pictures
Authors: Grigaliunaite V.; Pileliene L.
Abstract: Research background: Endeavouring to develop healthy societies is a primary goal in many countries. As smoking is a major problem of public health, lowering the extent of smoking is one of the conditions for developing a healthy society. Based on the research revealing that the pairing of the product with negative stimuli enhances the possibility of negative reaction to the product as negative stimulus transfers it's meaning to the product, tobacco packaging was labelled with negative smoking-related pictures illustrating the danger of smoking. Nevertheless, the extent of smoking is still large in many countries. Hence, the effect of negative smoking-related pictures has been the subject of intense debate within the scientific community. Purpose of the article: The aim of this research is to determine the effect of negative smoking-related pictures on the both implicit and explicit attitude toward smoking. Methods: For the purpose of determining the effect of negative smoking-related pictures on the both implicit and explicit attitude toward smoking, Implicit Association Test and questionnaire survey were provided. The questionnaire was elaborated based on the analysis and synthesis of scientific literature. Findings & Value added: The theoretical analysis substantiated the influence of attitude toward the product on consumer purchase decisions. Nevertheless, people do not always want to reveal their opinion, hence traditional marketing research methods for measuring explicit attitude are not sufficient as they are often not objective. Therefore, neuromarketing research methods complement traditional marketing research methods by providing more objectivity. Consequently, the Implicit Association Test and traditional questionnaire research are applied for the empirical research, revealing the effect of negative smokingrelated pictures on the both implicit and explicit attitude toward smoking. The recommendations for the usage of negative smoking-related pictures on purpose to influence attitude toward smoking and consumer purchase behaviour are substantiated. © 2017 Nicolaus Copernicus University. All rights reserved.
Keywords: Consumer behaviour; Explicit attitude; Mplicit attitude; Negative pictures; Smoking
keywords: negative stimuli, attitude, consumer purchase decisions, implicit and explicit attitude, emotional data
rationale: The abstract discusses the impact of negative smoking-related pictures on attitudes toward smoking, which relates directly to understanding customer emotions and attitudes. The research aims to measure implicit and explicit attitudes, indicating a focus on emotional responses and customer understanding. Thus, it aligns with the objectives related to customer understanding and emotional needs, fitting well within the Feeling AI category.
resumo: O desenvolvimento de sociedades saudáveis é um objetivo primordial em muitos países, e a redução do tabagismo, um grande problema de saúde pública, é fundamental para alcançar esse objetivo. Pesquisas mostram que a associação de produtos com estímulos negativos pode aumentar a reação negativa a esses produtos. Assim, embalagens de tabaco foram rotuladas com imagens negativas relacionadas ao fumo, ilustrando seus perigos. No entanto, o tabagismo ainda é prevalente em muitos lugares, e o impacto dessas imagens é debatido na comunidade científica. Este estudo visa determinar o efeito dessas imagens negativas nas atitudes implícitas e explícitas em relação ao tabagismo, utilizando o Teste de Associação Implícita e questionários. A análise teórica destaca a influência das atitudes nas decisões de compra dos consumidores, mas métodos tradicionais de pesquisa muitas vezes não capturam opiniões objetivas. Portanto, métodos de neuromarketing são utilizados para complementar as pesquisas tradicionais, proporcionando maior objetividade. As descobertas revelam o impacto das imagens negativas nas atitudes em relação ao tabagismo e oferecem recomendações para seu uso visando influenciar comportamentos de compra.

Title: The relationship between unstructured information and marketing knowledge: An experiment in the US wine market
Authors: Scorrano P.; Fait M.; Maizza A.
Abstract: The aim of this paper is to assess, with a view to marketing strategies, the potential of a marketing intelligence software application designed to extract information from non-structured web sources (typically websites and social media). The paper also proposes a conceptual model that SMEs can use to transform simple qualitative and quantitative data into knowledge that is useful for supporting the decision-making process in the context of international marketing. The presentation of the proposed interpretative model is followed by the application to the wine market in the USA. Comparison of the themes typical of online discourse in the worlds of supply and demand highlights a certain communicative misalignment that SMEs can resolve by adopting suitable communicative strategies. Copyright © 2015 Inderscience Enterprises Ltd.
Keywords: Consumer behaviour; Information extraction; Marketing intelligence; Social network; Text mining; Website; Wine
keywords: marketing intelligence, decision-making, international marketing, qualitative and quantitative data, communicative strategies
rationale: The abstract discusses a marketing intelligence software application aimed at extracting information from non-structured web sources to support decision-making in international marketing. It emphasizes the transformation of data into useful knowledge, which aligns with market analysis and strategic decision-making. Moreover, the mention of communicative strategies indicates a focus on targeting and understanding market dynamics, which are key elements of thinking AI.
resumo: O objetivo deste artigo é avaliar, com foco em estratégias de marketing, o potencial de um software de inteligência de marketing projetado para extrair informações de fontes web não estruturadas (tipicamente websites e redes sociais). O artigo também propõe um modelo conceitual que as PMEs podem usar para transformar dados qualitativos e quantitativos simples em conhecimento útil para apoiar o processo de tomada de decisão no contexto do marketing internacional. A apresentação do modelo interpretativo proposto é seguida pela aplicação ao mercado de vinhos nos EUA. A comparação dos temas típicos do discurso online nos mundos da oferta e da demanda destaca um certo desalinhamento comunicativo que as PMEs podem resolver adotando estratégias comunicativas adequadas.

Title: Mobile shopping behaviour: Insights into attitudes, shopping process involvement and location
Authors: Holmes A.; Byrne A.; Rowley J.
Abstract: Purpose: Although there is evidence that adoption of mobile shopping has been slow, the increased functionality offered by smart phones offers significant potential for the development of marketing and retailing through the mobile channel. The purpose of this paper is to add to knowledge on consumer shopping behaviour through mobile devices by exploring attitudes to the use of mobiles in shopping, the use of mobile phones at different stages in the consumer decision-making process, the impact of involvement on the mobile consumer decision-making process and mobile shopping location. Design/methodology/approach: An online panel survey was conducted with a UK panel of nationally representative consumers. The survey collected data in respect of the following products that were ranked on level of involvement on the basis of the importance and effort consumers' associated with their purchase: bread (lowest), washing powder, DVD, footwear, phone and TV (highest). Findings: Use of mobiles for shopping is significant, but remains lower than use of computers in shopping. In general, respondents were more positive regarding their use of computer shopping than they were in relation to their use of a mobile. In using their mobile phone in shopping, respondents value its convenience and accessibility. There is higher use of the mobile phone in the information search and consideration of alternatives phases, than in the purchase transaction. The extent of use of mobile devices in the decision-making process is higher with higher involvement products, in relation to all stages in the decision-making process. The most frequent location for the use of their mobile in shopping is at home, which is consistent with the finding that the highest level of use of mobiles occurs in the information search and consideration of alternatives phases. Recommendations are offered for retailers and for further research. Originality/value: This is the first research to explore the use of mobile phones in different stages in the consumer-decision-making process across a number of product categories. © Emerald Group Publishing Limited.
Keywords: Consumer behaviour; Consumer decision making; Involvement; Mobile shopping; Smart phones
keywords: consumer shopping behaviour, attitudes, decision-making process, involvement, convenience, accessibility
rationale: The abstract explores consumer attitudes and behaviors in mobile shopping, focusing on how emotional aspects like convenience and accessibility influence their decision-making process. It emphasizes understanding customer needs during different stages of shopping, aligning well with the objectives of Feeling AI, which aims to understand and meet customer emotional needs and wants.
resumo: O objetivo deste artigo é contribuir para o conhecimento sobre o comportamento de compra dos consumidores por meio de dispositivos móveis, explorando atitudes em relação ao uso de celulares nas compras, a utilização de telefones móveis em diferentes etapas do processo de decisão do consumidor, o impacto do envolvimento no processo de decisão de compra móvel e a localização das compras móveis. Foi realizada uma pesquisa online com um painel representativo de consumidores do Reino Unido, coletando dados sobre produtos classificados por nível de envolvimento. Os resultados mostram que o uso de celulares para compras é significativo, mas ainda inferior ao uso de computadores. Os entrevistados demonstraram maior satisfação com as compras pelo computador do que pelo celular, valorizando a conveniência e acessibilidade do telefone móvel. O uso do celular é mais frequente nas fases de busca de informações e consideração de alternativas do que na transação de compra. O uso de dispositivos móveis é mais intenso em produtos de maior envolvimento em todas as etapas do processo de decisão. A maioria das compras móveis ocorre em casa, alinhando-se ao maior uso durante a busca de informações. O artigo oferece recomendações para varejistas e para futuras pesquisas. Esta é a primeira pesquisa a explorar o uso de celulares em diferentes etapas do processo de decisão do consumidor em várias categorias de produtos.

Title: Predicting consumer decisions to adopt mobile commerce: Cross country empirical examination between China and Malaysia
Authors: Chong A.Y.-L.; Chan F.T.S.; Ooi K.-B.
Abstract: Advancements in wireless communications have increased the number of people using mobile devices, and have accelerated the growth of mobile commerce (m-commerce). This study aims to investigate the factors that predict consumer intention to adopt m-commerce in Malaysia and China. The work extends the traditional technology acceptance model (TAM) and diffusion of innovation (DOI) model, and includes additional variables such as trust, cost, social influence, variety of services, and control variables such as age, educational level, and gender of consumers. By comparing consumers from both Malaysia and China, this research is able to form a prediction model based on two different cultural settings. Data was collected from 172 Malaysian consumers and 222 Chinese consumers, and hierarchical regression analysis was employed to test the research model. The results showed that age, trust, cost, social influence, and variety of services are able to predict Malaysian consumer decisions to adopt m-commerce. Trust, cost, and social influence can be used to predict Chinese consumer decisions to adopt m-commerce. This research confirms the need to extend the traditional TAM and DOI models when studying technology such as m-commerce. The results from this study will be useful for telecommunication and m-commerce companies in formulating marketing strategies. © 2012 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved.
Keywords: Consumer behaviour; Hierarchical regression analysis; M-commerce; Technology acceptance model (TAM)
keywords: consumer intention, adopt m-commerce, predict, trust, social influence, marketing strategies, cultural settings
rationale: The abstract discusses the investigation of factors predicting consumer intention to adopt m-commerce, along with the formation of a prediction model based on cultural settings. This aligns with the market analysis and targeting focus of Thinking AI, as it involves understanding consumer behavior and formulating marketing strategies. The study employs hierarchical regression analysis, which is indicative of analyzing data to derive insights about market trends and consumer preferences.
resumo: Avanços nas comunicações sem fio aumentaram o número de pessoas utilizando dispositivos móveis e aceleraram o crescimento do comércio móvel (m-commerce). Este estudo investiga os fatores que preveem a intenção do consumidor de adotar o m-commerce na Malásia e na China. O trabalho amplia o modelo tradicional de aceitação de tecnologia (TAM) e o modelo de difusão da inovação (DOI), incluindo variáveis adicionais como confiança, custo, influência social, variedade de serviços e variáveis de controle como idade, nível educacional e gênero dos consumidores. Ao comparar consumidores da Malásia e da China, a pesquisa forma um modelo preditivo baseado em dois contextos culturais diferentes. Os dados foram coletados de 172 consumidores malaios e 222 consumidores chineses, e a análise de regressão hierárquica foi utilizada para testar o modelo de pesquisa. Os resultados mostraram que idade, confiança, custo, influência social e variedade de serviços podem prever as decisões dos consumidores malaios de adotar o m-commerce. Confiança, custo e influência social podem prever as decisões dos consumidores chineses. Esta pesquisa confirma a necessidade de ampliar os modelos TAM e DOI tradicionais ao estudar tecnologias como o m-commerce. Os resultados deste estudo serão úteis para empresas de telecomunicações e m-commerce na formulação de estratégias de marketing.

Title: The effects of blogger recommendations on customers' online shopping intentions
Authors: Hsu C.-L.; Lin J.C.-C.; Chiang H.-S.
Abstract: Purpose: Blogging has become part of a consumer's decision making process when shopping online; however, the understanding of blog recommendation's effect on consumer purchase decision is still vague. The purpose of this study is to examine whether the blog reader's trusting belief in the blogger is significant in relation to the perceived usefulness of the blogger's recommendations; and how the blog reader's perceptions influence his/her attitude and purchasing behavior online. The moderating effect of blogger's reputation on readers' purchasing intentions is also tested. Design/methodology/approach: Based on various theories, a model was proposed in this study. A survey involving 327 blog readers as participants was analyzed in the empirical study to investigate whether the usefulness of bloggers' recommendations and trusting beliefs toward blogger had influence on consumers' attitudes and behavioral intentions toward online shopping. Findings: The results indicated that perceived usefulness of bloggers' recommendations and trust had significant influential effect on blog users' attitude towards and intention to shop online. Moreover, the findings showed that different determinants affected the users of perceived-high-reputation and perceived-low-reputation blogs. Originality/value: The findings suggest bloggers' electronic word-of-mouth (eWOM) to be a promising marketing strategy for increasing sales. The marketers should provide free trial products and services to the perceived-high-reputation bloggers who, as valued opinion leaders, will influence and prompt others to shop online through a trusting effect. As for perceived-low-reputation bloggers, the marketing strategists should strive to emphasize the usefulness of products and services being marketed, so these perceived-low-reputation bloggers can focus more on describing the advantages and benefits of products or services discussed in their blogs. © Emerald Group Publishing Limited.
Keywords: Blogging; Blogs; Consumer behaviour; Electronic commerce; Online shopping; Recommendations; Reputation; Trust
keywords: trust, attitude, purchasing behavior, perceived usefulness, "bloggers reputation"
rationale: The abstract focuses on the emotional and relational aspects of consumer behavior influenced by bloggers' recommendations. It highlights the importance of trust and perceived usefulness in shaping consumers' attitudes and purchasing decisions, which aligns with the objectives of Feeling AI to understand customer emotional needs and tailor experiences. The findings suggest a significant emotional engagement with the content provided by bloggers, particularly regarding their reputation, which further emphasizes the emotional connection in consumer decision-making.
resumo: O blogging se tornou parte do processo de decisão de compra dos consumidores ao fazer compras online; no entanto, a compreensão do efeito das recomendações de blogs na decisão de compra ainda é vaga. Este estudo tem como objetivo examinar se a crença de confiança do leitor do blog no blogueiro é significativa em relação à utilidade percebida das recomendações do blogueiro e como as percepções do leitor influenciam sua atitude e comportamento de compra online. Também é testado o efeito moderador da reputação do blogueiro nas intenções de compra dos leitores. Com base em várias teorias, um modelo foi proposto e uma pesquisa com 327 leitores de blogs foi analisada para investigar se a utilidade das recomendações dos blogueiros e as crenças de confiança em relação ao blogueiro influenciam as atitudes e intenções comportamentais dos consumidores em relação às compras online. Os resultados indicaram que a utilidade percebida das recomendações dos blogueiros e a confiança tiveram um efeito significativo na atitude dos usuários de blogs em relação à compra online. Além disso, os achados mostraram que diferentes determinantes afetaram os usuários de blogs de alta e baixa reputação percebida. Os resultados sugerem que o boca a boca eletrônico (eWOM) dos blogueiros é uma estratégia de marketing promissora para aumentar as vendas. Os profissionais de marketing devem fornecer produtos e serviços de teste gratuito para blogueiros de alta reputação percebida, que, como líderes de opinião valorizados, influenciarão e incentivarão outros a comprar online por meio de um efeito de confiança. Quanto aos blogueiros de baixa reputação percebida, os estrategistas de marketing devem enfatizar a utilidade dos produtos e serviços sendo comercializados, para que esses blogueiros possam se concentrar mais em descrever as vantagens e benefícios dos produtos ou serviços discutidos em seus blogs.

Title: The fallout from French nuclear testing in the South Pacific: A longitudinal study of consumer boycotts
Authors: Ettenson R.; Klein J.G.
Abstract: Purpose - The frequency and sophistication of consumer boycotts continue to increase from already high levels. Surprisingly, only limited research in marketing has investigated this topic. The purpose of this paper is to provide a strategic analysis of an actual consumer protest with implications for better managerial decisions. Design/methodology/approach - The animosity model of consumer purchase behavior was employed in two longitudinal studies to investigate an ongoing marketplace protest - Australian consumers' boycott of French products. Study 1 was carried out while France was engaged in nuclear testing in the South Pacific. Study 2 was carried out 1 year after the resolution of the conflict. Findings - Results from Study 1 show that Australian consumers' animosity toward France was negatively related to their willingness to purchase French products. Consistent with a key prediction from the animosity model, this effect was independent of evaluations of French product quality. The findings from Study 2 show that, a year after the cessation of nuclear testing, Australian consumers continue to have strong negative affect toward France, which in turn, had negative marketplace consequences for French products. Originality/value - While the results from Study 1 show that consumer anger over nuclear testing did not necessarily lead to the denigration of the quality of French goods, the second study indicates that, beyond the duration of the official protest, there may be repercussions for products associated with the offending party. Accordingly, managers should consider implementing communications programs which, over time, effectively reinforce the quality of their products in the minds of protesting consumers. © Emerald Group Publishing Limited.
Keywords: Brands; Consumer behaviour; International business
keywords: animosity, consumer protest, negative affect, emotional data, managerial decisions
rationale: The abstract discusses consumer boycotts driven by emotional responses such as animosity and negative affect towards a country due to its actions. The findings emphasize the importance of understanding customer emotions and their impact on purchasing behavior, which aligns closely with the focus on customer understanding and emotional needs in the Feeling AI category.
resumo: O propósito deste artigo é fornecer uma análise estratégica de um protesto de consumidores, com implicações para decisões gerenciais. Foram realizados dois estudos longitudinais para investigar o boicote de consumidores australianos a produtos franceses, motivado pelos testes nucleares da França no Pacífico Sul. O Estudo 1 revelou que a animosidade dos consumidores australianos em relação à França estava negativamente relacionada à disposição de comprar produtos franceses, independentemente da avaliação da qualidade desses produtos. O Estudo 2, realizado um ano após a resolução do conflito, mostrou que os consumidores australianos ainda mantinham um forte sentimento negativo em relação à França, resultando em consequências negativas para os produtos franceses no mercado. Os resultados sugerem que, mesmo após o término do protesto, pode haver repercussões para produtos associados ao país ofensor, indicando que os gerentes devem considerar a implementação de programas de comunicação que reforcem a qualidade de seus produtos na mente dos consumidores em protesto ao longo do tempo.

Title: Mobile shopping behaviour: Insights into attitudes, shopping process involvement and location
Authors: Holmes A.; Byrne A.; Rowley J.
Abstract: Purpose: Although there is evidence that adoption of mobile shopping has been slow, the increased functionality offered by smart phones offers significant potential for the development of marketing and retailing through the mobile channel. The purpose of this paper is to add to knowledge on consumer shopping behaviour through mobile devices by exploring attitudes to the use of mobiles in shopping, the use of mobile phones at different stages in the consumer decision-making process, the impact of involvement on the mobile consumer decision-making process and mobile shopping location. Design/methodology/approach: An online panel survey was conducted with a UK panel of nationally representative consumers. The survey collected data in respect of the following products that were ranked on level of involvement on the basis of the importance and effort consumers' associated with their purchase: bread (lowest), washing powder, DVD, footwear, phone and TV (highest). Findings: Use of mobiles for shopping is significant, but remains lower than use of computers in shopping. In general, respondents were more positive regarding their use of computer shopping than they were in relation to their use of a mobile. In using their mobile phone in shopping, respondents value its convenience and accessibility. There is higher use of the mobile phone in the information search and consideration of alternatives phases, than in the purchase transaction. The extent of use of mobile devices in the decision-making process is higher with higher involvement products, in relation to all stages in the decision-making process. The most frequent location for the use of their mobile in shopping is at home, which is consistent with the finding that the highest level of use of mobiles occurs in the information search and consideration of alternatives phases. Recommendations are offered for retailers and for further research. Originality/value: This is the first research to explore the use of mobile phones in different stages in the consumer-decision-making process across a number of product categories. © Emerald Group Publishing Limited.
Keywords: Consumer behaviour; Consumer decision making; Involvement; Mobile shopping; Smart phones
keywords: consumer shopping behaviour, attitudes, decision-making process, involvement, convenience, accessibility
rationale: The abstract explores consumer attitudes and behaviors in mobile shopping, focusing on how emotional aspects like convenience and accessibility influence their decision-making process. It emphasizes understanding customer needs during different stages of shopping, aligning well with the objectives of Feeling AI, which aims to understand and meet customer emotional needs and wants.
resumo: O objetivo deste artigo é ampliar o conhecimento sobre o comportamento de compra dos consumidores por meio de dispositivos móveis, explorando atitudes em relação ao uso de celulares nas compras, sua utilização em diferentes etapas do processo de decisão do consumidor, o impacto do envolvimento nesse processo e a localização das compras móveis. Foi realizada uma pesquisa online com um painel representativo do Reino Unido, coletando dados sobre produtos classificados por nível de envolvimento, desde pão (mais baixo) até TV (mais alto). Os resultados mostram que o uso de celulares para compras é significativo, mas ainda inferior ao uso de computadores. Os respondentes demonstraram uma atitude mais positiva em relação às compras por computador do que por celular, valorizando a conveniência e acessibilidade do celular. O uso do celular é mais frequente nas fases de busca de informações e consideração de alternativas do que na transação de compra. A utilização de dispositivos móveis é maior para produtos de maior envolvimento em todas as etapas do processo decisório. A maioria das compras móveis ocorre em casa, alinhando-se ao fato de que o uso mais elevado de celulares acontece nas fases de busca de informações e consideração de alternativas. Recomendações são oferecidas para varejistas e para futuras pesquisas. Este é o primeiro estudo a explorar o uso de celulares em diferentes etapas do processo de decisão do consumidor em várias categorias de produtos.

Title: Effect of shopper attributes on retail format choice behaviour for food and grocery retailing in India
Authors: Prasad C.J.; Aryasri A.R.
Abstract: Purpose: Retailing in India is an unchartered territory. Food and grocery is the most promising area for setting up retail business in India. An understanding of shopper retail format choice behaviour will enable retailers to segment their market and target specific consumer groups with strategies premeditated to meet their retail needs. The purpose of this paper is to make a detailed study on the effect of shoppers' demographic, geographic and psychographic dimensions in terms of format choice behaviour in the fast growing Indian food and grocery retailing. Design/methodology/approach: Descriptive research design is adopted applying mall intercept survey method using structured questionnaire for data collection. Both descriptive (mean and standard deviation) and inferential statistical tools like χ2, factor analysis and multivariate analysis are used to analyse the data collected from 1,040 food and grocery retail customers from upgraded neighbourhood kirana stores, convenience stores, supermarkets and hypermarkets in conjoint cities of Secunderabad and Hyderabad in Andhra Pradesh in India. Findings: The findings suggest that shoppers' age, gender, occupation, education, monthly household income, family size and distance travelled to store have significant association with retail format choice decisions. The choice decisions are also varied among shoppers' demographic attributes. The findings from shoppers' psychographic dimensions like values, lifestyle factors and shopping orientations resulted in segmentation of food and grocery retail consumers into hedonic, utilitarian, autonomous, conventional and socialization type. Practical implications: The study has practical implications for food and grocery retailers for better understanding the shopper behaviour in the context of changing consumer demographic and psychographic characteristics in an emerging Indian retail market. The findings may help the retailers to segment and target the food and grocery retail consumers and, as a consequence, to undertake more effective retail marketing strategies for competitive advantage. Originality/value: Given the absence of published academic literature and empirical findings relating to store format choice behaviour in food and grocery retailing in India, this study may serve as a departure point for future studies in this area of concern. The research is also relevant to retail marketers in terms of format development and reorientation of marketing strategies in the fastest growing Indian retail market. © Emerald Group Publishing Limited.
Keywords: Consumer behaviour; Demographics; India; Psychographics; Retailing
keywords: shopper behaviour, market segmentation, target specific consumer groups, demographic dimensions, psychographic dimensions, format choice behaviour, marketing strategies
rationale: The abstract discusses the analysis of shopper behavior and market segmentation in the context of food and grocery retailing in India. It emphasizes understanding demographic and psychographic factors influencing format choice decisions, which aligns with market analysis and targeting. The findings suggest practical implications for retailers to tailor their marketing strategies based on customer insights, which is indicative of using analytical approaches to improve targeting and competitive advantage.
resumo: O objetivo deste estudo é analisar o comportamento de escolha de formato de varejo entre consumidores de alimentos e produtos de supermercado na Índia, um mercado em crescimento. Utilizando um método de pesquisa descritiva com questionários estruturados, foram coletados dados de 1.040 clientes em diferentes tipos de lojas em Secunderabad e Hyderabad. Os resultados indicam que fatores demográficos, como idade, gênero, ocupação, educação, renda familiar mensal, tamanho da família e distância até a loja, influenciam as decisões de escolha de formato de varejo. Além disso, as dimensões psicográficas dos consumidores permitiram segmentá-los em grupos hedônicos, utilitários, autônomos, convencionais e sociais. As implicações práticas do estudo ajudam os varejistas a entender melhor o comportamento do consumidor, permitindo segmentação e estratégias de marketing mais eficazes. Este estudo é pioneiro na literatura acadêmica sobre o comportamento de escolha de formato de loja na Índia, servindo como base para futuras pesquisas na área.

Title: An integrated model for predicting consumer's intention to write online reviews
Authors: Dixit S.; Jyoti Badgaiyan A.; Khare A.
Abstract: For marketers, consumers’ increasing use of online reviews in arriving at purchase decisions is a double edged sword. On one hand, it presents opportunity for manufacturers and sellers to be highlighted for their good work, but at the same time, there remains a possibility of negative review impacting goodwill and reputation.
